```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Load packages 

library(dplyr)
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(data.table)
library(ggpubr)
library(here)
library(knitr)


```

```{r}
# -----------------------------------------
# TIMEPOINT 1 ANALYSIS 
# -----------------------------------------

# Load the raw data file and create a phyloseq object 

# uploaded file with ASVs 

asv_raw <- read.csv("Trimester2CS/Mergedfiles_EmilyEditFullASVs.csv", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

taxonomy_strings <- asv_raw[[1]]

asv_ids <- paste0("ASV", seq_len(nrow(asv_raw)))

rownames(asv_raw) <- asv_ids

count_data <- asv_raw[, -1, drop = FALSE]

count_data[] <- lapply(count_data, as.numeric)

otu_mat <- as.matrix(count_data)

tax_split <- strsplit(taxonomy_strings, ";")

tax_mat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tax_split, function(x) {
  length(x) <- 7
  return(x)
}))

colnames(tax_mat) <- c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")
rownames(tax_mat) <- asv_ids

OTU <- otu_table(otu_mat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
TAX <- tax_table(as.matrix(tax_mat))
ps <- phyloseq(OTU, TAX)

```


```{r}
# combine with metadata 

metadata <- read.csv("Trimester2CS/T2CrossSectionMetadata_UpdatedSamples.csv")
setwd("../../../")
cst_data <- read.csv("CSTData.csv") # retrieve CST file generated from VALENCIA output 
names(cst_data)[names(cst_data) == "NEWsampleID"] <- "Sample_ID"
names(metadata)[names(metadata) == "Barcode_Sample.Name"] <- "Sample_ID"
metadata <- merge(metadata, cst_data[, c("Sample_ID", "CST")], by = "Sample_ID", all.x = TRUE)

rownames(metadata) <- metadata$Sample_ID
metadata <- metadata[, !names(metadata) %in% "Sample_ID"]
sample_data(ps) <- sample_data(metadata)


```

```{r}
# Run this to make sure no samples are dropped 

otu_samples <- sample_names(ps) 
meta_samples <- sample_names(metadata)
  
intersect(otu_samples, meta_samples)         
setdiff(otu_samples, meta_samples)          
setdiff(meta_samples, otu_samples)           

# All samples have been included if you see NULL

```



```{r}
# Filtering and data cleaning  

# Remove singletons
ps.prune = prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps) > 1, ps)


# Remove taxa that occur in less than 5% of samples 

ps.prune <- filter_taxa(ps.prune, function(x) sum(x > 0) > 0.05 * nsamples(ps), TRUE)

# Check read count
readcount_sr = data.table(as(sample_data(ps.prune), "data.frame"),
                 TotalReads = sample_sums(ps.prune), 
                 keep.rownames = TRUE)
setnames(readcount_sr, "rn", "SampleID")

```

```{r}

# Check read count and determine which PIDs to remove from the data set 

readcount <- (readcount_sr[order(readcount_sr$TotalReads), c("SampleID", "TotalReads", "PID")])

print(readcount)


```


```{r}

# Remove samples with reads below 200 and use this phyloseq for upcoming analyses 

ps.filtered = subset_samples(ps.prune, PID != "SMH48" & PID != "SMH85")

# use this phyloseq for upcoming analyses! 
```

```{r}

# sequencing depth by group 

# pre paper sequencing depth qc between groups 

# BEFORE SPECIES / TAXA REMOVAL - SO ALL SPECIFICALLY RELATING TO ALPHA DIVERSITY 

# calculate sequencing depth between groups 

ps.alpha <- ps

ps.alpha <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps.alpha) >= 200, ps.alpha)

# Sequencing depth after filtering
readcount <- data.frame(
  SampleID = sample_names(ps.alpha),
  TotalReads = sample_sums(ps.alpha),
  sample_data(ps.alpha)
)

# Check the distribution

readcount$Ethnicity_HIV <- paste(readcount$Ethnicity, readcount$HIV_Status, sep=" ")

# Overall summary
readcount %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median_reads = median(TotalReads, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR_reads = IQR(TotalReads, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q1 = quantile(TotalReads, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(TotalReads, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_reads = min(TotalReads, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_reads = max(TotalReads, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# By subgroup
depth_summary_group <- readcount %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median_reads = median(TotalReads, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR_reads = IQR(TotalReads, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q1 = quantile(TotalReads, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(TotalReads, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_reads = min(TotalReads, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_reads = max(TotalReads, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

depth_summary_group

# View lowest-depth samples
readcount %>%
  arrange(TotalReads) %>%
  select(SampleID, PID, Ethnicity_HIV, TotalReads)

ReadDepth <- ggplot(readcount,
       aes(x = Ethnicity_HIV, y = TotalReads)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(aes(group = timepoint), position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.7),
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Sequencing depth (reads)",
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),  
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),  
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, face = "italic"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11)
  )

ReadDepth

# supplementary figure 3

#ggsave(
#"ReadCountQC.tiff",
#ReadDepth,
#width = 220,
#height = 170,
#units = "mm",
#dpi = 600,
#device = "tiff",
#bg = "white",
#compression = "lzw")


kruskal.test(TotalReads ~ Ethnicity_HIV, data = readcount)

pairwise.wilcox.test(
  x = readcount$TotalReads,
  g = readcount$Ethnicity_HIV,
  p.adjust.method = "BH"
)

kruskal.test(TotalReads ~ Ethnicity, data = readcount)
kruskal.test(TotalReads ~ HIV_Status, data = readcount)

```

```{r}

# gestational age figure 

AverageGAOverall <- metadata.filtered %>%

    count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"

library(ggplot2)

  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV = recode(
      Ethnicity_HIV,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+"  = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-"  = "White PWWH"
    )
  )

AverageGA <- metadata.filtered %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_GA = mean(Gestational.age1.wks, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_GA = min(Gestational.age1.wks, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_GA = max(Gestational.age1.wks, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    label_y = max(Gestational.age1.wks, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.5,
    label = paste0(
      "Mean: ", sprintf("%.2f", mean_GA),
      "\nRange: ", sprintf("%.0f", min_GA), "–", sprintf("%.0f", max_GA)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(AverageGA)

x_labels <- AverageGA %>%
  mutate(axis_label = paste0(Ethnicity_HIV, "\n(n=", n, ")")) %>%
  select(Ethnicity_HIV, axis_label) %>%
  tibble::deframe()

GABreakdownPlot <- ggplot(metadata.filtered, aes(x = Ethnicity_HIV, y = Gestational.age1.wks)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "skyblue", color = "darkblue") +

    data = AverageGA,
    aes(x = Ethnicity_HIV, y = label_y, label = label),

      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.25
    ),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2)
```

``` {r}
# Demographic data table 

# Full data table for PWLWH and PWWH - first create demographic dataframe 


demographic.dataframe <- metadata.filtered %>% select(PID, ARV.backbone, Base.drug, ART.Group, Age, Ethnicity, HIV_Status, Gestational.age1.wks, Gravida.number, Previous.livebirths.number, Term.birth, GA.at.delivery.weeks, Date.ART.commenced, CD4.count.at.screening.cells.mcL, HIV.viral.load.at.screening.copies.mL, Ethnicity_HIV, Body.Mass.Index.of.mother, Current.Alcohol.use, History.of.Alcohol.Excess, Current.tobacco.use, Preterm.birth.risk, previous.poor.outcome, previous.cervical.procedures, Fibroids, hypertensive.disorders, Diabetes.during.pregnancy, antibiotic.exposure, progesterone, cervical.cerclage, PPROM, FGR, Fetal.distress, Reduced.FM, prior.sPTB) 

demographic.dataframe$GA.at.delivery.weeks <- as.numeric( demographic.dataframe$GA.at.delivery.weeks)

demographic.dataframe <- demographic.dataframe %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV = recode(
      Ethnicity_HIV,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+"  = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-"  = "White PWWH"
    )
  )

demographic_summary <- demographic.dataframe %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_age = mean(Age, na.rm = FALSE),
    GAatVisit = mean(Gestational.age1.wks, na.rm = FALSE), 
    GADelivery = mean(GA.at.delivery.weeks, na.rm = TRUE),
    Gravidity = mean(Gravida.number, na.rm = FALSE),
    Parity = mean(Previous.livebirths.number, na.rm = FALSE),
    PTB = sum(Term.birth == "N", na.rm = FALSE)
  )


print(demographic_summary)
```

```{r}
# Creating table with statistical comparisons 

# load additional packages 

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(broom)


all_vars <- c("Age", "Body.Mass.Index.of.mother", "Gestational.age1.wks","GA.at.delivery.weeks", "Gravida.number", "Previous.livebirths.number","Preterm.birth.risk", "previous.poor.outcome","prior.sPTB", "previous.cervical.procedures","Fibroids","hypertensive.disorders","Diabetes.during.pregnancy","antibiotic.exposure","progesterone", "cervical.cerclage","PPROM","FGR", "Fetal.distress","Reduced.FM","Current.Alcohol.use", "History.of.Alcohol.Excess", "Current.tobacco.use", "Term.birth")

p_values <- map_dfr(
  all_vars,
  function(var) {
    x_raw <- demographic.dataframe[[var]]
    g <- demographic.dataframe$Ethnicity_HIV

    p <- NA
    test <- NA

    x_chr <- as.character(x_raw)
    x_chr_trim <- trimws(tolower(x_chr))
    
    missing_flag <- is.na(x_raw) |
      x_chr_trim %in% c("", "no record", "No record")
    
    missing_n <- sum(missing_flag, na.rm = TRUE)

    x_clean <- x_raw
    x_clean[missing_flag] <- NA

    if (var %in% c(
      "Age",
      "Body.Mass.Index.of.mother",
      "Gestational.age1.wks",
      "GA.at.delivery.weeks",
      "Gravida.number",
      "Previous.livebirths.number")) {
      
      x_num <- suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(as.character(x_clean)))
      
      group_counts <- tapply(
        !is.na(x_num),
        g,
        sum)

      if (
        all(!is.na(group_counts)) &&
        all(group_counts > 0)
      ) {
        p <- tryCatch(
          kruskal.test(x_num ~ g)$p.value,
          error = function(e) NA
        )
        
        test <- "Kruskal–Wallis"
      }

    } else {
      
      x_cat <- as.character(x_clean)
      
      x_cat <- ifelse(
        tolower(trimws(x_cat)) == "yes",
        "Yes",
        ifelse(
          tolower(trimws(x_cat)) == "no",
          "No",
          x_cat
        )
      )
      
      x_cat <- factor(x_cat)

      tbl <- table(
        g,
        x_cat,
        useNA = "no")

      non_missing_per_group <- tapply(
        !is.na(x_cat),
        g,
        sum)

      if (
        all(!is.na(non_missing_per_group)) &&
        all(non_missing_per_group > 0) &&
        nrow(tbl) > 1 &&
        ncol(tbl) > 1) {
        
        expected <- suppressWarnings(
          chisq.test(tbl)$expected)

        if (any(expected < 5, na.rm = TRUE)) {
          
          p <- tryCatch(
            fisher.test(
              tbl,
              simulate.p.value = TRUE,
              B = 1e5
            )$p.value,
            error = function(e) NA)
          
          test <- "Fisher’s Exact (MC)"
          
        } else {
          
          p <- suppressWarnings(
            chisq.test(tbl)$p.value
          )
          
          test <- "Chi-square"
        }
      }
    }

    tibble(
      Variable = var,
      p_value = round(p, 4),
      Test = test,
      Missing = missing_n
    )
  }
)

# pairwise fetal distress test

groups <- unique(na.omit(demographic.dataframe$Ethnicity_HIV))

comparisons <- combn(groups, 2, simplify = FALSE)

fisher_fetal_distress <- map_dfr(comparisons, function(grp) {
  
  data_test <- demographic.dataframe %>%
    filter(
      Ethnicity_HIV %in% grp,
      !is.na(Fetal.distress),
      trimws(tolower(as.character(Fetal.distress))) %in% c("yes", "no")) %>%
    mutate(
      Fetal.distress = ifelse(
        tolower(trimws(as.character(Fetal.distress))) == "yes",
        "Yes",
        "No"))
  
  tbl <- table(
    data_test$Ethnicity_HIV,
    data_test$Fetal.distress)
  
  tibble(
    Group1 = grp[1],
    Group2 = grp[2],
    P = fisher.test(tbl)$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(
    P.adj = p.adjust(P, method = "BH")
  )

print(fisher_fetal_distress)
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)

# Create dataframe for HIV+ participants only
demographic.dataframe_HIV <- metadata.filtered %>%
  select(
    PID, ARV.backbone, Base.drug, ART.Group, Age, Ethnicity, HIV_Status,
    Gestational.age1.wks, Gravida.number, Previous.livebirths.number,
    Term.birth, GA.at.delivery.weeks, Complication, Date.ART.commenced,
    CD4.count.at.screening.cells.mcL, ViralLoad_Screening_Numerical, Visit.Date
  ) %>%
  filter(HIV_Status == "HIV+") %>%
  mutate(
    GA.at.delivery.weeks = as.numeric(GA.at.delivery.weeks),
    ARTStartDate = if_else(Date.ART.commenced == "precon", as.Date(NA), dmy(Date.ART.commenced)),
    ART_precon_flag = Date.ART.commenced == "precon",
    VisitDate = dmy(Visit.Date),
    weeks_on_ART_precon = as.numeric(VisitDate - ARTStartDate) / 7,
    ViralLoad_Screening_Numerical = as.numeric(ViralLoad_Screening_Numerical),
    VL_over_50_flag = ViralLoad_Screening_Numerical > 50,
    Precon_flag = Date.ART.commenced == "precon"
  )
ethnicity_labels <- demographic.dataframe_HIV %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity) %>%
  summarise(n_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Ethnicity_label = paste0(Ethnicity, " (n=", n_count, ")")) %>%
  select(-n_count)

demographic.dataframe_HIV <- demographic.dataframe_HIV %>%
  left_join(ethnicity_labels, by = "Ethnicity") %>%
  mutate(Ethnicity = Ethnicity_label) %>%
  select(-Ethnicity_label)

median_iqr <- function(x) {
  med <- sprintf("%.2f", median(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  q1  <- sprintf("%.2f", quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE))
  q3  <- sprintf("%.2f", quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE))
  paste0(med, " (", q1, "–", q3, ")")
}

# Baseline summary table
baseline_stats <- demographic.dataframe_HIV %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    CD4 = median_iqr(CD4.count.at.screening.cells.mcL),
    ViralLoad = median_iqr(ViralLoad_Screening_Numerical),
    VL_over_50_flag = paste0(
      sum(VL_over_50_flag, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
      sprintf("%.2f", 100 * mean(VL_over_50_flag, na.rm = TRUE)), "%)"
    ),
    Precon = paste0(
      sum(Precon_flag, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
      sprintf("%.2f", 100 * mean(Precon_flag, na.rm = TRUE)), "%)"
    ),
    Postcon = paste0(
      sum(!Precon_flag, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
      sprintf("%.2f", 100 * mean(!Precon_flag, na.rm = TRUE)), "%)"
    ),
    weeks_on_ART = median_iqr(weeks_on_ART_precon),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Overall p-values for baseline comparisons
p_CD4 <- suppressWarnings(
  wilcox.test(CD4.count.at.screening.cells.mcL ~ Ethnicity, data = demographic.dataframe_HIV)$p.value
)
p_ViralLoad <- suppressWarnings(
  wilcox.test(ViralLoad_Screening_Numerical ~ Ethnicity, data = demographic.dataframe_HIV)$p.value
)
p_VL_over_50 <- fisher.test(table(demographic.dataframe_HIV$VL_over_50_flag, demographic.dataframe_HIV$Ethnicity))$p.value
p_Precon <- fisher.test(table(demographic.dataframe_HIV$Precon_flag, demographic.dataframe_HIV$Ethnicity))$p.value

# Build long baseline table and attach correct p-values
baseline_long <- baseline_stats %>%
  mutate(across(-Ethnicity, as.character)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Ethnicity, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(
    p_value = case_when(
      Variable == "CD4" ~ p_CD4,
      Variable == "ViralLoad" ~ p_ViralLoad,
      Variable == "VL_over_50_flag" ~ p_VL_over_50,
      Variable == "Precon" ~ p_Precon,
      Variable == "Postcon" ~ p_Precon,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

baseline_wide <- baseline_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Ethnicity, values_from = Value) %>%
  relocate(p_value, .after = last_col())

# Function to summarise ART subgroup rows with p-values
summarise_ART_by_subgroup <- function(df, group_var) {
  df_summary <- df %>%
    group_by(Ethnicity, !!sym(group_var)) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Ethnicity) %>%
    mutate(
      pct = sprintf("%.2f", 100 * n / sum(n)),
      value = paste0(n, " (", pct, "%)")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  subgroups <- unique(df[[group_var]])

  results <- lapply(subgroups, function(sub) {
    df_tmp <- df %>% mutate(sub_flag = .data[[group_var]] == sub)
    tbl <- table(df_tmp$sub_flag, df_tmp$Ethnicity)
    p_val <- if (all(dim(tbl) == c(2, 2))) fisher.test(tbl)$p.value else NA_real_

    values <- df_summary %>%
      filter(.data[[group_var]] == sub) %>%
      select(Ethnicity, value) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = Ethnicity, values_from = value)

    values %>%
      mutate(Variable = sub, p_value = p_val) %>%
      select(Variable, everything())
  })

  bind_rows(results)
}

ART_summary <- summarise_ART_by_subgroup(demographic.dataframe_HIV, "ART.Group")
ART_backbone_summary <- summarise_ART_by_subgroup(demographic.dataframe_HIV, "ARV.backbone")

# Combine all sections
final_summary <- bind_rows(
  baseline_wide,
  tibble(Variable = "ART Class", p_value = NA_real_),
  ART_summary,
  tibble(Variable = "ART Backbone", p_value = NA_real_),
  ART_backbone_summary
)

# Drop sample-size row if not wanted
final_summary_clean <- final_summary[-c(1), ]

# Rename if needed
colnames(final_summary_clean)[colnames(final_summary_clean) == "Unknown"] <- "unknown"
final_summary_clean <- final_summary_clean %>%
  mutate(Variable = ifelse(Variable == "unknown", "Unknown", Variable)) %>%
  filter(Variable != "Unknown")

# Add missing-data column consistently
final_summary_clean <- final_summary_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Missing = case_when(
      Variable == "ART Class" ~ "0",
      Variable == "VL_over_50_flag" ~ "4",
      Variable == "ART Backbone" ~ "1",
      Variable %in% c("II", "NNRTI", "PI", "Other",
                      "FTC/TDF", "3TC/ABC", "FTC/TAF",
                      "3TC/ABC/ZDV", "TDF/3TC", "ABC/3TC") ~ "",
      TRUE ~ "0"
    )
  )

# Blank section header values only
value_cols <- setdiff(names(final_summary_clean), c("Variable", "p_value", "Missing"))

final_summary_clean <- final_summary_clean %>%
  mutate(across(
    all_of(value_cols),
    ~ if_else(Variable %in% c("ART Class", "ART Backbone"), "", as.character(.))
  ))

# Format p-values only once at the end
final_summary_clean <- final_summary_clean %>%
  mutate(
    p_value = case_when(
      Variable %in% c("ART Class", "ART Backbone") ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ p_value
    ),
    p_value = case_when(
      is.na(p_value) ~ "",
      p_value < 0.01 ~ sprintf("%.2e", p_value),
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.2f", p_value)
    )
  )

final_summary_clean
```

```{r}

# Alpha diversity compared between subgroups 

library(FSA)

# chao1 before any species removal in phyloseq

ps.alpha <- ps

ps.alpha <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps.alpha) >= 200, ps.alpha)

ad.metadats <- sample_data(ps.alpha)    

ad.metadats <- data.frame(ad.metadats)

ad.metadats$Ethnicity_HIV <- paste(ad.metadats$Ethnicity, ad.metadats$HIV_Status, sep=" ")

sample_data(ps.alpha) <- ad.metadats

# adiv via chao 

metadata <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps.alpha))

metadata$SampleID <- rownames(metadata)
metadata$TotalReads <- sample_sums(ps.alpha)

adiv <- phyloseq::estimate_richness(ps.alpha, measures = c("Chao1")) %>%
  cbind(metadata[, c("Ethnicity", "HIV_Status", "Ethnicity_HIV", "PID", "Gestational.age1.wks", "Age", "Body.Mass.Index.of.mother", "Sequencing.batch", "TotalReads", "Extraction.year")]) %>%
  as.data.frame()

adiv <- adiv %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV = recode(
      Ethnicity_HIV,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+"  = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-"  = "White PWWH"
    )
  )

sample_counts <- adiv %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(Ethnicity_HIV, "\n(n=", n, ")"))

adiv_labeled <- adiv %>%
  left_join(sample_counts, by = "Ethnicity_HIV")

group_levels <- unique(adiv_labeled$label)
comparisons <- combn(group_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE)


# global KW of AD 

kw <- kruskal.test(Chao1 ~ label, data = adiv_labeled)
print(kw$p.value)

# Global KW was significant - follow up with Dunn's to assess pairwise comparisons 

dunn <- dunnTest(Chao1 ~ label, data = adiv_labeled, method = "bh")

pval_table <- dunn$res %>%
  select(group1 = Comparison, p.adj = P.adj) %>%
  separate(group1, into = c("group1", "group2"), sep = " - ")

pval_table <- pval_table %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, 3))

# p value formatting 

pval_table <- pval_table %>%
  mutate(
    p.formatted = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
      p.adj < 0.01  ~ sprintf("%.3f", p.adj),
      TRUE          ~ sprintf("%.2f", p.adj)
    ),
    p.signif = case_when(
      p.adj <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.adj <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.adj <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  )

max_val <- max(adiv_labeled$Chao1, na.rm = TRUE)
range_val <- diff(range(adiv_labeled$Chao1, na.rm = TRUE))

step <- range_val * 0.05

pval_table <- pval_table %>%
  arrange(group1, group2) %>%
  mutate(y.position = max_val + seq_len(n()) * step)


adiv_labeled$Ethnicity_HIV <- factor(adiv_labeled$Ethnicity_HIV,
  levels = c("Black PWLWH", "Black PWWH", "White PWLWH", "White PWWH")
)

# Saving final figure with no titles and pdf 

adiv_plot1 <- ggplot(adiv_labeled, aes(x = label, y = Chao1)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Ethnicity_HIV), width = 0.2, size = 2, alpha = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Ethnicity and HIV Status",
    y = "Chao1 Diversity Index"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Ethnicity and HIV Status", values = c(
  "Black PWLWH" = "#4C78A8", 
  "White PWLWH" = "#F58518", 
  "Black PWWH"  = "#72B7B2",  
  "White PWWH"  = "#B279A2"  
  ))+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
theme(
  axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
  axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
  legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",   
      fill = NA,        
      linewidth = 0.25), 
  axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2)
) +
stat_pvalue_manual(
  pval_table,
  label = "p.formatted",
  tip.length = 0.02,
  hide.ns = TRUE,
  inherit.aes = FALSE
)

adiv_plot1
```

```{r}
 # alpha diversity full figure with Chao1, Shannon, and Simpson 

# Compute all alpha diversity metrics 

adiv <- phyloseq::estimate_richness(
  ps.filtered,
  measures = c("Chao1", "Shannon", "Simpson")
) %>%
  cbind(sample_data(ps.filtered)[, c("Ethnicity_HIV", "PID")]) %>%
  as.data.frame()


adiv_long <- adiv %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Chao1, Shannon, Simpson),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

adiv_long <- adiv_long %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV = recode(
      Ethnicity_HIV,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+"  = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-"  = "White PWWH"
    )
  )


adiv_long$Ethnicity_HIV <- factor(
  adiv_long$Ethnicity_HIV,
  levels = c("Black PWLWH", "Black PWWH", "White PWLWH", "White PWWH")
)

# KW for each metric - all sig so follow up with Dunn's tests 

kw_results <- adiv_long %>%
  group_by(Metric) %>%
  summarise(p = kruskal.test(Value ~ Ethnicity_HIV)$p.value)

print(kw_results) # global 

# Dunn's tests within each metric 

library(rstatix)

dunn_table <- adiv_long %>%
  group_by(Metric) %>%
  dunn_test(Value ~ Ethnicity_HIV, p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj")

dunn_table <- dunn_table %>%
  mutate(
    p.formatted = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
      p.adj < 0.01  ~ sprintf("%.3f", p.adj),
      TRUE          ~ sprintf("%.2f", p.adj)
    )
  )

# y positions in each panel 

adiv_long <- adiv_long %>%
  group_by(Metric) %>%
  mutate(y.max = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

dunn_table <- dunn_table %>%
  left_join(adiv_long %>% distinct(Metric, y.max), by = "Metric") %>%
  group_by(Metric) %>%
  mutate(
    y.position = y.max + (row_number() * 0.05 * y.max)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


print(dunn_table)

adiv_plot <- ggplot(adiv_long, aes(x = Ethnicity_HIV, y = Value)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Ethnicity_HIV),
              width = 0.2, size = 2, alpha = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ Metric, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Black PWLWH" = "#4C78A8", 
  "White PWLWH" = "#F58518", 
  "Black PWWH"  = "#72B7B2",  
  "White PWWH"  = "#B279A2" 
  )) +
   labs(
    x = "Ethnicity and HIV Status",
    y = "Diversity Index"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
theme(
  axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
  axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
  legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",   
      fill = NA,        
      linewidth = 0.25), 
  axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2)
) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    dunn_table,
    label = "p.formatted",
    xmin = "group1",
    xmax = "group2",
    y.position = "y.position",
    tip.length = 0.01,
    hide.ns = TRUE
  )
```

```{r}
# Beta diversity between subgroups 

# Bray BD 

bray <- phyloseq::distance(ps.filtered, method = "bray")

ordination <- ordinate(ps.filtered, method = "PCoA", distance = "bray")

permanova_result <- adonis2(bray ~ Ethnicity_HIV, data = as(sample_data(ps.filtered), "data.frame"), permutations = 999)

# global PERMANOVA to assess BD overall 

pval <- permanova_result$`Pr(>F)`[1]

print(pval) 

ord_df <- plot_ordination(ps.filtered, ordination, type = "samples", justDF = TRUE)
ord_df$Ethnicity_HIV <- sample_data(ps.filtered)$Ethnicity_HIV

# Get % variance explained by each axis

eig_vals <- ordination$values$Eigenvalues
percent_var <- round(100 * eig_vals / sum(eig_vals), 1)

# add variance to x and y label to be displayed on plot 

xlab <- paste0("PCoA1 (", percent_var[1], "%)")
ylab <- paste0("PCoA2 (", percent_var[2], "%)")


ord_df <- ord_df %>%
  mutate(
    group = recode(
      Ethnicity_HIV,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",

)

# Pairwise test to assess beta diversity between subgroups (after significant global PERMANOVA)

#devtools::install_github("pmartinezarbizu/pairwiseAdonis/pairwiseAdonis") # if needed to install package 

library(pairwiseAdonis)

meta <- data.frame(sample_data(ps.filtered))

pairwise_res_combo <- pairwise.adonis2(bray ~ Ethnicity_HIV, data = meta, permutations = 999)

head(pairwise_res_combo)

# dispersion between groups 

library(vegan)

metadata <- as(sample_data(ps.filtered), "data.frame")

# testing homogeneity of multivariate dispersion 

bd <- betadisper(bray, metadata$Ethnicity_HIV)

# permutation test

permutest(bd, permutations = 999)

# pairwise comparisons - all NS

TukeyHSD(bd)

# gestational age permanova sensitivity

permanova_result <- adonis2(bray ~ Gestational.age1.wks + Ethnicity_HIV, data = as(sample_data(ps.filtered), "data.frame"), permutations = 999)

print(permanova_result)

# GA sequencing batch and log10 reads permanova sensitivity adjustment

metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(ps.filtered))

metadata$Sequencing.batch <- as.factor(metadata$Sequencing.batch)

permanova_result <- adonis2(bray ~ Sequencing.batch + Ethnicity_HIV, data = metadata, "data.frame", permutations = 999)

print(permanova_result)

# plus log10 reads

metadata <- as(sample_data(ps.filtered), "data.frame")

metadata$TotalReads <- sample_sums(ps.filtered)
metadata$log_TotalReads <- log10(metadata$TotalReads)

metadata$Sequencing.batch <- factor(metadata$Sequencing.batch)

permanova_result <- adonis2(bray ~ Sequencing.batch + Ethnicity_HIV + log_TotalReads, data = metadata, "data.frame", permutations = 999)

print(permanova_result)

# extraction year

metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(ps.filtered))

metadata$Extraction.year <- as.factor(metadata$Extraction.year)

permanova_result <- adonis2(bray ~ Extraction.year + Ethnicity_HIV, data = metadata, "data.frame", permutations = 999)

print(permanova_result)

# full technical model 

metadata <- as(sample_data(ps.filtered), "data.frame")

metadata$TotalReads <- sample_sums(ps.filtered)
metadata$log_TotalReads <- log10(metadata$TotalReads)

metadata$Sequencing.batch <- factor(metadata$Sequencing.batch)

permanova_result <- adonis2(bray ~ Sequencing.batch + Ethnicity_HIV + log_TotalReads + Extraction.year, data = metadata, "data.frame", permutations = 999)

print(permanova_result)


# pairwise of above - batches first  

library(pairwiseAdonis)

pairwise_res_combo <- pairwise.adonis2(bray ~ Ethnicity_HIV + Sequencing.batch, data = metadata, permutations = 999)

head(pairwise_res_combo)
```

```{r}

# Fisher's tests between subgroups to identify individual CSTs (not groupings) that are significantly different between subgroups

# All were NS and not included in manuscript but kept here for reference 

library(tibble)

cst_long <- cst_proportion %>%
  uncount(Count)

cst_summary <- cst_proportion %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  mutate(
    Total = sum(Count),
    Proportion = round(100 * Count / Total, 1),
    Label = paste0(Count, " (", Proportion, "%)")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cst_wide <- cst_summary %>%
  select(CST, Ethnicity_HIV, Label) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Ethnicity_HIV,
    values_from = Label,
    values_fill = "0 (0%)"
  )

cst_overall <- cst_proportion %>%
  group_by(CST) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = sum(Count),
    Proportion = round(100 * sum(Count) / sum(cst_proportion$Count), 1),
    Label = paste0(Total, " (", Proportion, "%)")
  )

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  left_join(cst_overall %>% select(CST, Overall = Label), by = "CST")

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  arrange(factor(CST, levels = c("I","II","III","IV-A","IV-B","IV-C","V")))

groups <- unique(cst_long$Ethnicity_HIV)
pairwise_groups <- combn(groups, 2, simplify = FALSE)

# Fisher's tests to examine CST prevalence between all subgroups 

pairwise_results <- map_df(unique(cst_long$CST), function(cst_type) {
  map_df(pairwise_groups, function(gpair) {
    table_2x2 <- cst_long %>%
      filter(Ethnicity_HIV %in% gpair) %>%
      mutate(CST_binary = if_else(CST == cst_type, cst_type, "Other")) %>%
      count(CST_binary, Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = Ethnicity_HIV, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
      column_to_rownames("CST_binary") %>%
      as.matrix()
    
    if (nrow(table_2x2) < 2 || ncol(table_2x2) < 2 ||
        any(rowSums(table_2x2) == 0) || any(colSums(table_2x2) == 0)) {
      return(tibble(CST = cst_type, Group1 = gpair[1], Group2 = gpair[2], p_value = NA_real_))
    }
    
    fisher_res <- fisher.test(table_2x2, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 10000)
    
    tibble(
      CST = cst_type,
      Group1 = gpair[1],
      Group2 = gpair[2],
      p_value = fisher_res$p.value
    )
  })
})

pairwise_results <- pairwise_results %>%
  mutate(
    q_value = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr") 
  )

print(pairwise_results)

# ALL NS
```

```{r}

# CST regression models - assignment to CST IV or CSTs I+II+V 

CSTModel <- data.frame(
  SampleID = metadata.filtered$PID,
  CST = metadata.filtered$CST,
  GAAge = metadata.filtered$Gestational.age1.wks,
  HIV = metadata.filtered$HIV_Status,
  Ethnicity = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity,
  Age = metadata.filtered$Age,
  Gravidity = metadata.filtered$Gravida.number,
  Term = metadata.filtered$Term.birth,
  Ethnicity_HIV = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity_HIV,
  Complication = metadata.filtered$Complication,
  BMI = metadata.filtered$Body.Mass.Index.of.mother,
  SeqBatch = metadata.filtered$Sequencing.batch,
  ExtractYear = metadata.filtered$Extraction.year
)

psalpha_meta <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps.alpha))


psalpha_meta$TotalReads <- sample_sums(ps.alpha)

CSTModel$TotalReads <- psalpha_meta$TotalReads[
  match(CSTModel$SampleID, psalpha_meta$PID)
]
 # matching metadata to raw reads in order to include as covariate in models 

CSTModel <- CSTModel %>%
  mutate(Term = ifelse(Term == "y", "Y", Term))

CSTModel <- CSTModel %>%
  mutate(CSTIV = CST %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C"))

CSTModel <- CSTModel %>%
  mutate(CSTIIIV = CST %in% c("I", "II", "V"))

CSTModel$CSTIV <- factor(CSTModel$CSTIV, levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE")) # testing if assigned to CST IV 
CSTModel$CSTIIIV <- factor(CSTModel$CSTIIIV, levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE")) # testing if assigned to CST I+II+V
CSTModel$HIV <- factor(CSTModel$HIV, levels = c("HIV+", "HIV-"))
CSTModel$Ethnicity <- factor(CSTModel$Ethnicity, levels = c("Black", "White"))
CSTModel$GAAge <- as.numeric(CSTModel$GAAge)
CSTModel$Age <- as.numeric(CSTModel$Age)
CSTModel$Gravidity <- as.numeric(CSTModel$Gravidity)
CSTModel$Term <- factor(CSTModel$Term, levels = c("Y", "N"))
CSTModel$Complication <- factor(CSTModel$Complication, levels = c("N", "Y")) # odds of complication (complication = Y)
CSTModel$BMI <- as.numeric(CSTModel$BMI)
CSTModel$SeqBatch <- factor(CSTModel$SeqBatch)

# Odds of assignment to CST IV 

model <- glm(CSTIV ~ Ethnicity_HIV + Age + BMI, family = binomial, data = CSTModel)

summary(model)

# Odds of assignment to CST I + II + or V ("beneficial" CSTs)

model <- glm(CSTIIIV ~ Ethnicity_HIV + Age + BMI, family = binomial, data = CSTModel)

summary(model)

# Significant model - examine pairwise comparisons using emmeans 

library(emmeans)

em_model <- emmeans(model, pairwise ~ Ethnicity_HIV, type = "response", infer = c(TRUE, TRUE) )

contrasts_df <- as.data.frame(em_model$contrasts)

sig <- contrasts_df %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.10) %>%
  mutate(
    aOR = ifelse(odds.ratio < 1, 1 / odds.ratio, odds.ratio),
    LCL = ifelse(odds.ratio < 1, 1 / asymp.UCL, asymp.LCL),
    UCL = ifelse(odds.ratio < 1, 1 / asymp.LCL, asymp.UCL),
    report = paste0(
      "P: ", round(p.value, 2),
      ", aOR: ", round(aOR, 2),
      ", 95% CI: ", round(LCL, 2),
      "–", round(UCL, 2)
    )
  )

sig %>% select(contrast, report)

print(contrasts_df)

# Same model as above but with GA covariate for sensitivity 

model <- glm(CSTIIIV ~ Ethnicity_HIV + Age + BMI + SeqBatch, family = binomial, data = CSTModel)

summary(model) # NS effect of GA 

# get contrasts to report 

library(broom)

results <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%   
  mutate(
    report = paste0(
      "aOR ", round(estimate, 2),
      ", 95% CI ", round(conf.low, 2),
      "–", round(conf.high, 2),
      "; p = ", signif(p.value, 2)
    )
  )

results %>% select(term, report)
```

```{r}

# HIV only models for CST assignment 

CSTModelHIV <- data.frame(
  SampleID = metadata.filtered$PID,
  CST = metadata.filtered$CST,
  GAAge = metadata.filtered$Gestational.age1.wks,
  HIV = metadata.filtered$HIV_Status,
  Ethnicity = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity,
  Age = metadata.filtered$Age,
  Gravidity = metadata.filtered$Gravida.number,
  Term = metadata.filtered$Term.birth,
  Ethnicity_HIV = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity_HIV,
  Complication = metadata.filtered$Complication,
  VisitDate = metadata.filtered$Visit.Date,
  DateART = metadata.filtered$Date.ART.commenced, 
  CD4 = metadata.filtered$CD4.count.at.screening.cells.mcL,
  HIVVL = metadata.filtered$ViralLoad_Screening_Numerical, 
  ARTBackbone = metadata.filtered$ARV.backbone,
  ARTGroup = metadata.filtered$ART.Group,
  BMI = metadata.filtered$Body.Mass.Index.of.mother
)

CSTModelHIV <- CSTModelHIV %>% filter (HIV == "HIV+")

CSTModelHIV$HIVVL <- as.numeric(CSTModelHIV$HIVVL)

CSTModelHIV <- CSTModelHIV %>%
  mutate(DetectableHIV = HIVVL > 50) # detectable HIV - greater than 50 copies at visit 

CSTModelHIV <- CSTModelHIV %>%
  mutate(CSTIV = CST %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C"))

CSTModelHIV <- CSTModelHIV %>%
  mutate(CSTIIIV = CST %in% c("I", "II", "V"))

CSTModelHIV <- CSTModelHIV %>% mutate (PreconYN = DateART == "precon") # started ART preconception 


CSTModelHIV <- CSTModelHIV %>%
  mutate(DateART = gsub(" ", "", DateART)) # date of ART initiation (if during pregnancy)

CSTModelHIV <- CSTModelHIV %>%
  mutate(PreconYN = ifelse(DateART == "precon", TRUE, FALSE))


CSTModelHIV <- CSTModelHIV %>% mutate(Term = ifelse(Term == "y", "Y", Term))

CSTModelHIV$CSTIV <- factor(CSTModelHIV$CSTIV, levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE")) # testing assignment to CST IV
CSTModelHIV$CSTIIIV <- factor(CSTModelHIV$CSTIIIV, levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE")) # testing assignment to CST I+II+V 
CSTModelHIV$Ethnicity <- factor(CSTModelHIV$Ethnicity, levels = c("Black", "White"))
CSTModelHIV$GAAge <- as.numeric(CSTModelHIV$GAAge)
CSTModelHIV$Age <- as.numeric(CSTModelHIV$Age)
CSTModelHIV$Gravidity <- as.numeric(CSTModelHIV$Gravidity)
CSTModelHIV$Term <- factor(CSTModelHIV$Term, levels = c("Y", "N"))
CSTModelHIV$Complication <- factor(CSTModelHIV$Complication, levels = c("Y", "N")) # odds of complication 
CSTModelHIV$DetectableHIV <- factor(CSTModelHIV$DetectableHIV, levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE"))
CSTModelHIV$CD4 <- as.numeric(CSTModelHIV$CD4)
CSTModelHIV$PreconYN <- factor(CSTModelHIV$PreconYN, levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE"))
CSTModelHIV$BMI <- as.numeric(CSTModelHIV$BMI)

# Within HIV+ individuals, does detectable HIV level (>50 VL or not) impact the odds of assignment to CST I, II, or V? 

model <- glm(CSTIIIV ~ DetectableHIV + Age + BMI, family = binomial, data = CSTModelHIV)

summary(model)

# Does CD4 count (scaled per 100 count increase) impact assignment to CST I+II+V? 

CSTModelHIV$CD4_100 <- CSTModelHIV$CD4 / 100

model <- glm(CSTIIIV ~ CD4_100 + Age + BMI, family = binomial, data = CSTModelHIV)

summary(model)

# Trending result - find OR from this model 

library(broom)

results <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%   
  mutate(
    report = paste0(
      "aOR ", round(estimate, 2),
      ", 95% CI ", round(conf.low, 2),
      "–", round(conf.high, 2),
      "; p = ", signif(p.value, 2)
    )
  )

results %>% select(term, report)

summary(glm(CSTIIIV ~ CD4, family=binomial, data=CSTModelHIV))

# Do CD4 (per 100 count increase) adn HIV VL count impact CST assignment (CST I, II, or V)? 

CSTModelHIV$CD4_100 <- CSTModelHIV$CD4 / 100

model <- glm(CSTIIIV ~ CD4_100 + HIVVL+ Age + BMI, family = binomial, data = CSTModelHIV)

summary(model)

car:::vif(model)

# Yes - significant model 
 
# prediction plot for above model 

new_data <- data.frame(
  CD4_100 = seq(min(CSTModelHIV$CD4_100, na.rm = TRUE),
                max(CSTModelHIV$CD4_100, na.rm = TRUE),
                length.out = 100),
  HIVVL = mean(CSTModelHIV$HIVVL, na.rm = TRUE),
  Age   = mean(CSTModelHIV$Age, na.rm = TRUE),
  BMI   = mean(CSTModelHIV$BMI, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# Predict probabilities
new_data$pred <- predict(model, newdata = new_data, type = "response")


ggplot(new_data, aes(x = CD4_100, y = pred)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "CD4 count (per 100 cells/µL)",
       y = "Predicted Probability of CST I/II/V",
       title = "Predicted Probability of CSTIIIV") +
  theme_minimal()


preds <- predict(model, newdata = new_data, type = "link", se.fit = TRUE)

new_data$fit <- preds$fit
new_data$se  <- preds$se.fit

# Convert from log-odds to probability
new_data$prob <- plogis(new_data$fit)
new_data$lower <- plogis(new_data$fit - 1.96 * new_data$se)
new_data$upper <- plogis(new_data$fit + 1.96 * new_data$se)

HIVPP <- ggplot(new_data, aes(x = CD4_100, y = prob)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(x = "CD4 count (per 100 cells/µL)",
       y = "Predicted Probability of CST I, II, or V",
       title = "Predicted Probability of Optimal CSTs in PWLWH by CD4 Count",
       subtitle = "CD4 count correlated with increased odds of optimal CSTs I/II/V (p=0.03)"
       ) +
theme_gray() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", vjust = 0),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, face = "italic"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14)
  )

# Significant (CD4) - find OR from this model 

library(broom)

results <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%  
  mutate(
    report = paste0(
      "aOR ", round(estimate, 2),
      ", 95% CI ", round(conf.low, 2),
      "–", round(conf.high, 2),
      "; p = ", signif(p.value, 2)
    )
  )

results %>% select(term, report)

summary(glm(CSTIIIV ~ CD4, family=binomial, data=CSTModelHIV))

# ART models on assignment to CST I+II+V -- all NS 

# Does ART initiation timing (preconception vs during pregnancy binary) impact odds of CST assignment? 

model <- glm(CSTIIIV ~ PreconYN + GAAge, family = binomial, data = CSTModelHIV)

summary(model)

# of those who started during pregnancy, did days since starting ART or GA at ART initiation affect odds of CST assignment? 

CSTModelHIV_PregART <- CSTModelHIV %>% filter (PreconYN == "FALSE")

CSTModelHIV_PregART <- CSTModelHIV_PregART %>%
  mutate(VisitDate = as.Date(VisitDate, format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
    DateART = as.Date(DateART, format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
    Daysbetween = abs(as.numeric(DateART - VisitDate)))

model <- glm(CSTIIIV ~ Daysbetween + GAAge, family = binomial, data = CSTModelHIV_PregART)

summary(model)

# ART class and backbone models 

# Filter out ARTs not in NNRTI, PI, or II to resolve any small counts 

CSTModelHIV_ART <- CSTModelHIV %>% filter (ARTGroup != "Other")

# created combined model (ART group with NNRTI and PI) to try and overcome small events

CSTModelHIV_ART$ARTGroup_combined <- ifelse(CSTModelHIV_ART$ARTGroup %in% c("NNRTI", "PI"), "NNRTI_PI", as.character(CSTModelHIV_ART$ARTGroup))

# Convert to factor
CSTModelHIV_ART$ARTGroup_combined <- factor(CSTModelHIV_ART$ARTGroup_combined)

model <- glm(CSTIIIV ~ ARTGroup + BMI + Age, family = binomial, data = CSTModelHIV_ART)

summary(model)

# ART backbone and its impact on CST assignment -- just focusing on 3TC/ABC and FTC/TDF based on sample size 

CSTModelHIV_Backbones <- CSTModelHIV %>% filter (ARTBackbone %in% c("3TC/ABC", "FTC/TDF"))

CSTModelHIV_Backbones$ARTBackbone <- factor(CSTModelHIV_Backbones$ARTBackbone)

model <- glm(CSTIIIV ~ ARTBackbone + BMI + Age, family = binomial, data = CSTModelHIV_Backbones)

summary(model)
```

```{r}
# Relative abundance between subgroups of species with greater than 5% abundance in any sample 

# make counts out of 100 and melt to species level with name presented as genus species 

ps_rel_abund = transform_sample_counts(ps.filtered, function(x) x/sum(x)*100)
glom <- tax_glom(ps_rel_abund, taxrank = 'Species', NArm = FALSE)
ps.melt <- psmelt(glom)

# Select any species with greater than 5% abundance in any sample

ps.melt$Genus <- as.character(ps.melt$Genus)
ps.melt$Species <- as.character(ps.melt$Species)

ps.melt$GenusSpecies <- ifelse(
  is.na(ps.melt$Species) | ps.melt$Species == "" | ps.melt$Species == "unclassified",
  ps.melt$Genus,
  paste(ps.melt$Genus, ps.melt$Species, sep = " ")
)

top_taxa <- ps.melt %>%
  group_by(GenusSpecies, Sample) %>%           
  summarise(sample_abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(sample_abundance > 5) %>%             
  distinct(GenusSpecies) %>%                   
  pull(GenusSpecies)

ps.melt$GenusSpecies <- ifelse(ps.melt$GenusSpecies %in% top_taxa, 
                               ps.melt$GenusSpecies, 
                               "Other")

library(scales)
library(RColorBrewer)

palette1 <- brewer.pal(8, "Set1")       # 8 colors
palette2 <- brewer.pal(8, "Dark2")      # 8 colors
palette3 <- brewer.pal(8, "Paired")[1:8] # 8 colors

# Combine into a single 24-color palette
colors_24 <- c(palette1, palette2, palette3)


colors_24 <- c("#1B9E77", "#B2DF8A" ,"#984EA3", "#A6CEE3", "#FF7F00", "lightgoldenrod1", "#A65628", "#F781BF", "darkred" ,"#D95F02" ,"#7570B3" ,"#E7298A"  ,"#66C2A5" ,"#E6AB02", "indianred", "steelblue" ,"#A6761D" ,"lightgray" , "#E41A1C", "darkslateblue", "#FB9A99","#DECBE4" ,"darkgray","#FDDAEC")


ps.melt <- ps.melt %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV = recode(
      Ethnicity_HIV,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+"  = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-"  = "White PWWH"
    )
  )


ps.ethnicity_sum <- ps.melt %>%
  group_by(Sample, GenusSpecies,Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

total_abundance_per_sample <- ps.ethnicity_sum %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  summarise(TotalAbundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

ps.ethnicity_rel <- ps.ethnicity_sum %>%
  left_join(total_abundance_per_sample, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(RelAbundance = Abundance / TotalAbundance)

ps.ethnicity_label <- ps.ethnicity_rel %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV, GenusSpecies) %>%
  summarise(TotalRelAbundance = sum(RelAbundance), .groups = "drop")

sample_counts <- ps.ethnicity_rel %>%
  distinct(Sample, Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(Ethnicity_HIV, "\n(n=", n, ")"))

ps.ethnicity_label <- ps.ethnicity_label %>%
  left_join(sample_counts, by = c("Ethnicity_HIV"))

ps.ethnicity_label <- ps.ethnicity_label %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  mutate(NormRelAbundance = TotalRelAbundance / sum(TotalRelAbundance)) %>%
  ungroup()

ps.ethnicity_label$label <- factor(ps.ethnicity_label$label, levels = unique(ps.ethnicity_label$label))



# Final full figure that displays relative abundance of species with > 5% abundance in any sample by subgroup 

library(dplyr)
library(forcats)


ps.ethnicity_label <- ps.ethnicity_label %>%
  mutate(GenusSpecies = fct_reorder(
    GenusSpecies,
    NormRelAbundance,
    .fun = sum,
    .desc = TRUE
  )) 

RAplot <- ggplot(ps.ethnicity_label, aes(x = label, y = NormRelAbundance, fill = GenusSpecies)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.9, position = "stack") +
  labs(
    x = "Ethnicity and HIV Status",
    y = "Relative Abundance (%)",
    fill = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
theme(
  axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
  axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
  legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",   
      fill = NA,        
      linewidth = 0.25), 
  axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2)
) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_24) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1, byrow = TRUE))
```

```{r}

# Differential abundance between subgroups (ANCOM)

otu_mat <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps.filtered))
tax_mat <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps.filtered))

# preserve genus species labeling 

tax_mat$GenusSpecies <- ifelse(
  is.na(tax_mat$Species) | tax_mat$Species == "",
  tax_mat$Genus,
  paste(tax_mat$Genus, tax_mat$Species, sep = " ")
)

otu_agg <- aggregate(otu_mat, by = list(GenusSpecies = tax_mat$GenusSpecies), FUN = sum)
rownames(otu_agg) <- otu_agg$GenusSpecies
otu_agg$GenusSpecies <- NULL

tax_agg <- tax_mat[!duplicated(tax_mat$GenusSpecies), ]
rownames(tax_agg) <- tax_agg$GenusSpecies

tax_agg$GenusSpecies <- NULL

ps_genusspecies <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(as.matrix(otu_agg), taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
  tax_table(as.matrix(tax_agg)),
  sample_data(ps.filtered)
)

ps_genusspecies
rank_names(ps_genusspecies)

library(ANCOMBC)
output <- ancombc2(
  data = ps_genusspecies,            
  fix_formula = "Ethnicity_HIV",             
  rand_formula = NULL,                   
  p_adj_method = "fdr",                 
  pseudo_sens = TRUE,                    
  prv_cut = 0.10,                        
  lib_cut = 1000,                         
  s0_perc = 0.05,                        
  group = "Ethnicity_HIV",                     
  struc_zero = TRUE,                      
  neg_lb = TRUE,                          
  alpha = 0.05,                           
  n_cl = 2,                               
  verbose = TRUE,                         
  global = TRUE,                          
  pairwise = TRUE,                         
  dunnet = FALSE,                         
  trend = FALSE                            
)

# Global differential abundance (across all groups)
global_res <- output$res_global

# Pairwise comparisons between subgroups
pairwise_res <- output$res_pair

# Structural zeros (taxa absent in some groups)
struc_zeros <- output$zero_ind
```

```{r}
  ) %>%
  mutate(

    comparison = sub("^[^_]+_(.*)$", "\\1", metric_comparison),

  ) %>%
  select(taxon, comparison, metric, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = value)
```

```{r}
# cytokine comparisons between groups 

# select cytokines included in metadata file 

# original 5x2 cytokine figure 

cytokines <- metadata.filtered %>% 
  select(PID, Ethnicity_HIV, IFN_g, IL_10, IL_12p70, IL_13, IL_1b, IL_2, IL_4, IL_6, IL_8, TNF_a)

df_long <- cytokines %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(PID, Ethnicity_HIV),   
    names_to = "Cytokine",
    values_to = "Concentration"
  )

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(stringr)

# transform log10(x+1) to handle zeros in groups 

df_long_log <- df_long %>%
  mutate(Concentration_log = log10(Concentration + 1))

my_comparisons <- list(
  c("Black PWLWH", "White PWLWH"), 
  c("Black PWLWH", "White PWWH"), 
  c("Black PWWH",  "White PWLWH"), 
  c("Black PWLWH", "Black PWWH"), 
  c("Black PWWH",  "White PWWH"),
  c("White PWLWH", "White PWWH")
)

df_long_log <- df_long_log %>%
  mutate(Cytokine_plot = Cytokine %>%
           str_replace_all("TNF_a", "TNF-α") %>%
           str_replace_all("IL_1b", "IL-1β") %>%
           str_replace_all("IFN_g", "IFN-γ"))

df_long_log <- df_long_log %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV = recode(
      Ethnicity_HIV,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+"  = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-"  = "White PWWH"
    )
  )

df_counts <- df_long_log %>%
  group_by(Cytokine_plot, Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(!is.na(Concentration)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(ypos = -0.25)  

library(rstatix)

# Wilcoxon comparisons between groups 

pairwise_wilcox <- df_long_log %>%
  group_by(Cytokine_plot) %>%
  wilcox_test(Concentration_log ~ Ethnicity_HIV, p.adjust.method = "fdr") %>%
  ungroup()

pairwise_wilcox <- pairwise_wilcox %>%
  mutate(
    group1 = factor(group1, levels = c("Black PWLWH", "Black PWWH", "White PWLWH", "White PWWH")),
    group2 = factor(group2, levels = c("Black PWLWH", "Black PWWH", "White PWLWH", "White PWWH"))
  )


# Plot comparisons between groups with each cytokine in a facet 

library(ggsignif)
library(ggplot2)

df_long_log$Ethnicity_HIV <- factor(df_long_log$Ethnicity_HIV,
  levels = c("Black PWLWH", "Black PWWH", "White PWLWH", "White PWWH")
)
  

# Save version pdf for manuscript 

# trying to adjust the y position 

pairwise_wilcox <- pairwise_wilcox %>%
  group_by(Cytokine_plot) %>%
  arrange(group1, group2, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    ymin = min(df_long_log$Concentration_log[df_long_log$Cytokine_plot == first(Cytokine_plot)], na.rm = TRUE),
    maxy = max(df_long_log$Concentration_log[df_long_log$Cytokine_plot == first(Cytokine_plot)], na.rm = TRUE),
    yrange = maxy - ymin,

    step = 0.10 * yrange,
    base = maxy - 0.05 * yrange,

    y.position = base + step * (row_number() - 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

pval_table <- pairwise_wilcox %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    p.formatted = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
      p.adj < 0.01  ~ sprintf("%.3f", p.adj),
      TRUE          ~ sprintf("%.2f", p.adj)
    )
  )

CytoComp <- ggplot(df_long_log, aes(x = Ethnicity_HIV, y = Concentration_log, fill = Ethnicity_HIV)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 1, alpha = .8) +
  geom_label(
    data = df_counts,
    aes(x = Ethnicity_HIV, y = ypos, label = paste0("(n=", n, ")")),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "grey35",
    fill = "white", alpha = 0.8,
    label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines"), hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Cytokine_plot, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5,
             labeller = labeller(Cytokine_plot = function(x) str_replace_all(x, "_", "-"))) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Ethnicity and HIV Status", values = c(
  "Black PWLWH" = "#4C78A8",
  "White PWLWH" = "#F58518",
  "Black PWWH"  = "#72B7B2",
  "White PWWH"  = "#B279A2"
  )) +
  ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
    pval_table,
    label = "p.formatted",
    xmin = "group1",
    xmax = "group2",
    y.position = "y.position",
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    tip.length = 0.005
  ) +
  ylab("log10(Concentration+1)") +
  xlab("Ethnicity and HIV Status") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
theme(
  axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
  axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),

  axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 0.75, vjust = 0.85, size = 12),

  strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2),
  strip.text = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5),

  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),

  panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3),

  legend.title = element_blank(),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 13),

  axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2),
  axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm")
)
```

```{r}
      p.adj <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      TRUE            ~ "*"
    )
  )


CytoComp1 <- ggplot(df_long_log, aes(x = Ethnicity_HIV, y = Concentration_log, fill = Ethnicity_HIV)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) + 
    geom_label(
    data = df_counts,
    aes(x = Ethnicity_HIV, y = ypos, label = paste0("(n=", n, ")")),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,colour = "grey35",
    fill = "white", alpha = 0.8,
    label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines"), hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 4
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Cytokine_plot, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3,
             labeller = labeller(Cytokine_plot = function(x) str_replace_all(x, "_", "-"))) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Ethnicity and HIV Status", values = c(
  "Black PWLWH" = "#4C78A8",
  "White PWLWH" = "#F58518",
  "Black PWWH"  = "#72B7B2",
  "White PWWH"  = "#B279A2"
  )) +
  ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
    pval_table,
    label = "p.star",
    xmin = "group1",
    xmax = "group2",
    y.position = "y.position",
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    tip.length = 0.005,
    size = 5
  ) +
  ylab("log10(Concentration+1)") +
  xlab("Ethnicity and HIV Status") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
theme(
  axis.title.x = element_blank(),

)
```

```{r}

# Cytokines emmeans (adjusted for age and BMI) and table with pairwise results 

library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

CSTModel <- data.frame(
  SampleID = metadata.filtered$PID,
  CST = metadata.filtered$CST,
  GAAge = metadata.filtered$Gestational.age1.wks,
  HIV = metadata.filtered$HIV_Status,
  Ethnicity = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity,
  Age = metadata.filtered$Age,
  BMI = metadata.filtered$Body.Mass.Index.of.mother,
  Gravidity = metadata.filtered$Gravida.number,
  Term = metadata.filtered$Term.birth,
  Ethnicity_HIV = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity_HIV,
  Complication = metadata.filtered$Complication,
  IFN_g = metadata.filtered$IFN_g,
  IL_10 = metadata.filtered$IL_10,
  IL_12p70 = metadata.filtered$IL_12p70,
  IL_13 = metadata.filtered$IL_13,
  IL_1b = metadata.filtered$IL_1b,
  IL_2 = metadata.filtered$IL_2,
  IL_4 = metadata.filtered$IL_4,
  IL_6 = metadata.filtered$IL_6,
  IL_8 = metadata.filtered$IL_8,
  TNF_a = metadata.filtered$TNF_a
)

CSTModel <- CSTModel %>%
  mutate(Term = ifelse(Term == "y", "Y", Term))

CSTModel <- CSTModel %>%
  mutate(CSTIV = CST %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C"))

CSTModel <- CSTModel %>%
  mutate(CSTIIIV = CST %in% c("I", "II", "V"))

CSTModel$CSTIV <- factor(CSTModel$CSTIV, levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE")) # second level is what is being tested 
CSTModel$CSTIIIV <- factor(CSTModel$CSTIIIV, levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE"))
CSTModel$HIV <- factor(CSTModel$HIV, levels = c("HIV+", "HIV-"))
CSTModel$Ethnicity <- factor(CSTModel$Ethnicity, levels = c("Black", "White"))
CSTModel$GAAge <- as.numeric(CSTModel$GAAge)
CSTModel$Age <- as.numeric(CSTModel$Age)
CSTModel$Gravidity <- as.numeric(CSTModel$Gravidity)
CSTModel$Term <- factor(CSTModel$Term, levels = c("Y", "N")) # testing odds of preterm birth 
CSTModel$Complication <- factor(CSTModel$Complication, levels = c("Y", "N")) # odds of complication 
CSTModel$BMI <- as.numeric(CSTModel$BMI)

# cytokine columns 
cytokines <- c("IFN_g","IL_10","IL_12p70","IL_13","IL_1b","IL_2","IL_4","IL_6","IL_8","TNF_a")

# log x+1 transform cytokines in new dataset generated for model 

CSTModel[cytokines] <- lapply(CSTModel[cytokines], function(x) log10(x+1))

# Remove samples without cytokine data 

CSTModel_clean <- CSTModel %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cytokines), ~ ifelse(is.infinite(.x), NA, .x)))

# Create function for emmeans across all cytokines and store the results 

get_emm_all_pairs <- function(cyto, data) {

  m_adj <- lm(as.formula(paste(cyto, "~ Ethnicity_HIV + Age + BMI")), data = data)
  
  emm <- emmeans(m_adj, ~ Ethnicity_HIV)
  
  df_emm <- as.data.frame(emm) %>%
    mutate(Cytokine = cyto)
  
  pw <- pairs(emm)  #
  pw_df <- summary(pw) %>%
    select(contrast, estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.value) %>%
    mutate(Cytokine = cyto)
  
  pw_df <- pw_df %>%
    separate(contrast, into = c("Group1", "Group2"), sep = " - ")
  
  pw_df <- pw_df %>%
    mutate(
      p.value.global = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"),
      Significant = ifelse(p.value.global < 0.05, "Yes", "No")
    )
  
  pw_df <- pw_df %>%
    mutate(
      Group1 = gsub("[()]", "", Group1),
      Group2 = gsub("[()]", "", Group2),
      comparison = paste(Group1, "vs", Group2)
    )
  
  list(emmeans = df_emm, pairwise = pw_df)
}

results <- map(cytokines, ~ get_emm_all_pairs(.x, CSTModel_clean))

emm_all <- map_df(results, "emmeans")
pairwise_all <- map_df(results, "pairwise")

# Only significant comparisons
sig_pairs <- pairwise_all %>%
  filter(Significant == "Yes") %>%
  select(Cytokine, Group1, Group2, comparison, estimate, SE, t.ratio, p.value.global, df)

sig_pairs_table <- data.frame(
Cytokine = sig_pairs$Cytokine, 
Comparison = sig_pairs$comparison,
Estimate = sig_pairs$estimate,
SE = sig_pairs$SE,
P_adjusted = sig_pairs$p.value.global,
df = sig_pairs$df
)

sig_pairs_table

pairwise_all$Cytokine <- gsub("_", "-", pairwise_all$Cytokine)
pairwise_all$Cytokine <- gsub("g", "γ", pairwise_all$Cytokine)
pairwise_all$Cytokine <- gsub("a", "α", pairwise_all$Cytokine)
pairwise_all$Cytokine <- gsub("b", "β", pairwise_all$Cytokine)

full_data_table <- pairwise_all %>%
  select(
    Cytokine,
    Group1,
    Group2,
    comparison,
    estimate,
    SE,
    t.ratio,
    p.value.global,
    df
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group1 = recode(
      Group1,
      "Black HIV+" = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+" = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-" = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-" = "White PWWH"
    ),
    Group2 = recode(
      Group2,
      "Black HIV+" = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+" = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-" = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-" = "White PWWH"
    ),
    comparison = paste(Group1, "vs", Group2),
    p.value.global = as.numeric(p.value.global),
    estimate = as.numeric(estimate),
    SE = as.numeric(SE),
    df = as.numeric(df),
    CI_low = estimate - qt(0.975, df) * SE,
    CI_high = estimate + qt(0.975, df) * SE,
    cell_text = paste0(
      formatC(estimate, format = "f", digits = 2),
      " (",
      formatC(CI_low, format = "f", digits = 2),
      "-",
      formatC(CI_high, format = "f", digits = 2),
      "), ",
      ifelse(
        p.value.global < 0.01,
        formatC(p.value.global, format = "e", digits = 2),
        formatC(p.value.global, format = "f", digits = 2)
      ),
      ""
    )
  )

full_data_table_wide <- full_data_table %>%
  select(Cytokine, comparison, cell_text) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = comparison,
    values_from = cell_text
  )

gt_table <- full_data_table_wide %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    Cytokine = "Cytokine"
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(14)
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = everything()
  ) %>%
  cols_width(
    everything() ~ px(120)
  )

for (col in names(full_data_table_wide)[-1]) {

  pvals <- as.numeric(
    str_extract(
      full_data_table_wide[[col]],
      "(?<=; ).+(?=\\))"
    )
  )

  gt_table <- gt_table %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = col,
        rows = pvals < 0.05
      )
    )
}

gt_table


#gtsave(gt_table, "SupplementaryTable10.docx")


```

```{r}

# Creating a PCA of cytokine levels 

cytokines <- c("IFN_g", "IL_10", "IL_12p70", "IL_13", "IL_1b", "IL_2", "IL_4", "IL_6", "IL_8", "TNF_a")

cytokine_pca <- metadata.filtered %>% 
  select(PID, Ethnicity_HIV, CST, IFN_g, IL_10, IL_12p70, IL_13, IL_1b, IL_2, IL_4, IL_6, IL_8, TNF_a, Gestational.age1.wks, Age, Body.Mass.Index.of.mother, Ethnicity, HIV_Status)

cytokine_pca <- cytokine_pca %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cytokines), ~log10(.x + 1))) %>% # transform
  mutate(across(all_of(cytokines), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)))) # scale prior to PCA 

cytokine_pca_clean <- cytokine_pca %>%
  filter(!if_all(all_of(cytokines), is.na)) # samples without cytokine data 
cytokine_pca_run <- cytokine_pca_clean %>%
  select(IFN_g, IL_10, IL_12p70, IL_13, IL_1b, IL_2, IL_4, IL_6, IL_8, TNF_a)

# Run the PCA with two PCs 

library(pcaMethods)
pca_res <- pca(as.matrix(cytokine_pca_run), method = "nipals", nPcs = 2)

loadings_df <- loadings(pca_res)

# Loadings for each cytokine in PC1 and PC2 - all range from 0.26 - 0.34 for PC1 

print(loadings_df) # supplementary table 12

scores_df <- as.data.frame(scores(pca_res))

pca_res@R2

# Percent variance described by first component 

pc1_percent <- pca_res@R2[1] * 100
print(pc1_percent)

scores_df <- cbind(scores_df, cytokine_pca_clean) # final dataset with PCAs linked back to PID/CST/Ethnicity+HIV

scores_df <- scores_df %>%
  mutate(CSTFull = ifelse(CST %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C"), "IV", CST))

scores_df <- scores_df %>%
  mutate(CSTGroups = ifelse(CSTFull %in% c("I", "II", "V"), "I+II+V", CSTFull))

# PC1 models - ethnicity_HIV overall 

library(broom)

scores_df$Ethnicity_HIV <- relevel(factor(scores_df$Ethnicity_HIV), ref = "White PWWH")

model <- lm(PC1 ~ Ethnicity_HIV + Age + Body.Mass.Index.of.mother, data = scores_df)

summary(model)

results <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%   
  mutate(
    report = paste0(
      "β ", round(estimate, 2),
      ", 95% CI ", round(conf.low, 2),
      "–", round(conf.high, 2),
      "; p = ", signif(p.value, 2)
    )
  )

results %>% select(term, report)

library(emmeans)

emm <- emmeans(model, ~ Ethnicity_HIV)

emm
pairs(emm)

# get CIs

contrast_df <- as.data.frame(summary(pairs(emm), infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))
print(contrast_df)

# GA sensitivity of above 

model <- lm(PC1 ~ Ethnicity_HIV + Age + Body.Mass.Index.of.mother + Gestational.age1.wks, data = scores_df)

summary(model)

results <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%   
  mutate(
    report = paste0(
      "β ", round(estimate, 2),
      ", 95% CI ", round(conf.low, 2),
      "–", round(conf.high, 2),
      "; p = ", signif(p.value, 2)
    )
  )

results %>% select(term, report)

library(emmeans)

emm <- emmeans(model, ~ Ethnicity_HIV)

emm
pairs(emm)


# interaction 

model <- lm(PC1 ~ Ethnicity * HIV_Status + Age + Body.Mass.Index.of.mother, data = scores_df)

summary(model)

results <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%   
  mutate(
    report = paste0(
      "β ", round(estimate, 2),
      ", 95% CI ", round(conf.low, 2),
      "–", round(conf.high, 2),
      "; p = ", signif(p.value, 2)
    )
  )

results %>% select(term, report)

library(emmeans)

emm <- emmeans(model, ~ Ethnicity*HIV_Status)

emm
pairs(emm)

results %>%
  filter(term == "EthnicityWhite:HIV_StatusHIV+") # 95% CI 

# interaction sensitivity 

# interaction 

model <- lm(PC1 ~ Ethnicity * HIV_Status + Age + Body.Mass.Index.of.mother + Gestational.age1.wks, data = scores_df)

summary(model)

results <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%   
  mutate(
    report = paste0(
      "β ", round(estimate, 2),
      ", 95% CI ", round(conf.low, 2),
      "–", round(conf.high, 2),
      "; p = ", signif(p.value, 2)
    )
  )

results %>% select(term, report)

library(emmeans)

emm <- emmeans(model, ~ Ethnicity*HIV_Status)

emm
pairs(emm)

results %>%
  filter(term == "EthnicityWhite:HIV_StatusHIV+") # 95% CI
```

```{r}

# cytokine PCA between groups faceted by CST 

# Recreate previous dataframe as needed for analysis 

scores_df <- as.data.frame(scores(pca_res))

scores_df <- cbind(scores_df, cytokine_pca_clean) # final dataset with PCAs linked back to PID/CST/Ethnicity+HIV

scores_df <- scores_df %>%
  mutate(CSTFull = ifelse(CST %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C"), "IV", CST))

scores_df <- scores_df %>%
  mutate(CSTGroups = ifelse(CSTFull %in% c("I", "II", "V"), "I+II+V", CSTFull)) 

scores_df <- scores_df %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV = recode(
      Ethnicity_HIV,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+"  = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-"  = "White PWWH"
    )
  )

# Keep unadjusted p < 0.05 as some groups are very small 

library(rstatix)
pairwise_results <- scores_df %>%
  group_by(CSTGroups) %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    PC1 ~ Ethnicity_HIV,
    p.adjust.method = "fdr"
  ) %>%
  filter(p < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(CSTGroups) %>%
  mutate(
    maxy = max(scores_df$PC1[scores_df$CSTGroups == first(CSTGroups)], na.rm = TRUE),
    y.position = maxy + 0.25 * row_number()
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

pairwise_results <- pairwise_results %>%
  mutate(
    p_combined = sprintf(
        "%s (%s)",
        case_when(
       p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
        p < 0.01  ~ sprintf("%.3f", p),
        TRUE      ~ sprintf("%.2f", p)
      ),
    case_when(
    p.adj < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
    p.adj < 0.01  ~ sprintf("%.3f", p.adj),
    TRUE          ~ sprintf("%.2f", p.adj)
  )))

counts_df <- scores_df %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV, CSTGroups) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("n=", n))

scores_df$Ethnicity_HIV <- factor(scores_df$Ethnicity_HIV,
  levels = c("Black PWLWH", "Black PWWH", "White PWLWH", "White PWWH")
)


counts_df <- counts_df %>%
  mutate(
    y_pos = case_when(
      CSTGroups == "I+II+V" ~ -5.5,
      CSTGroups == "III" ~ -5.6,
      CSTGroups == "IV" ~ -3.6
    )
  )

# manuscript figure with significant comparisons only 

CSTInflammation <- ggplot(scores_df, aes(x = Ethnicity_HIV, y = PC1, fill = Ethnicity_HIV)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
 geom_label(
  data = counts_df,
  aes(x = Ethnicity_HIV, y = y_pos, label = label),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  fill = "white", color = "grey35", alpha = 0.1,
  label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines"), hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 4
) +
  facet_wrap(~CSTGroups, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Ethnicity and HIV Status",
    y = "PC1 (Overall Inflammation)"
  ) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Ethnicity and HIV Status", values = c(
  "Black PWLWH" = "#4C78A8",
  "White PWLWH" = "#F58518",
  "Black PWWH"  = "#72B7B2",
  "White PWWH"  = "#B279A2"
  )) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
theme(
  axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 0.8, vjust = 1, size = 12), 
  axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
  strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2),
  strip.text = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
  legend.position = "none",
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",   
      fill = NA,        
      linewidth = 0.25), 
  axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2)
)  +
  ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
    pairwise_results,
    label = "p_combined",
    xmin = "group1",
    xmax = "group2",
    y.position = "y.position",
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    tip.length = 0.01,
    size = 4
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.17))
)
  
CSTInflammation

# units = "mm",
# device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}

# tables with cytokine comparisons by CST for supplementary 

# Of samples assigned to CST I+II+V, what cytokines are significantly different between groups? 

metadata.filtered <- metadata.filtered %>%
  mutate(
    CSTFull = ifelse(CST %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C"), "IV", CST),
    CSTGroups = ifelse(CSTFull %in% c("I", "II", "V"), "I+II+V", CSTFull))

cytokines <- metadata.filtered %>% 
  select(PID, CSTGroups, Ethnicity_HIV, IFN_g, IL_10, IL_12p70, IL_13, IL_1b, IL_2, IL_4, IL_6, IL_8, TNF_a)

df_long <- cytokines %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(PID, Ethnicity_HIV, CSTGroups),   
    names_to = "Cytokine",
    values_to = "Concentration"
  ) %>%
  filter(CSTGroups %in% c("I+II+V")) # EDIT THIS AS NEEDED 

# Table for CST I+II+V 

# Log-transform
df_long_log <- df_long %>%
  mutate(Concentration_log = log10(Concentration + 1),
  Cytokine_plot = Cytokine %>%
           str_replace_all("TNF_a", "TNF-α") %>%
           str_replace_all("IL_1b", "IL-1β") %>%
           str_replace_all("IFN_g", "IFN-γ"))

df_long_log <- df_long_log %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV = recode(
      Ethnicity_HIV,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+"  = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-"  = "White PWWH"
    )
  )

df_counts <- df_long_log %>%
  group_by(Cytokine_plot, Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(!is.na(Concentration)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(ypos = -0.25)

df_long_log$Ethnicity_HIV <- factor(df_long_log$Ethnicity_HIV,
  levels = c("Black PWLWH", "Black PWWH", "White PWLWH", "White PWWH")
)

library(rstatix)
pairwise_wilcox <- df_long_log %>%
  group_by(Cytokine_plot) %>%
  wilcox_test(Concentration_log ~ Ethnicity_HIV, p.adjust.method = "fdr") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(group1 = group1, group2 = group2)

pairwise_wilcox_wide <- pairwise_wilcox %>%
  mutate(comparison = paste(group1, "vs", group2)) %>%
  select(Cytokine_plot, comparison, p.adj) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = comparison,
    values_from = p.adj
  )

pairwise_wilcox_wide <- pairwise_wilcox_wide %>%
  mutate(Cytokine_plot = gsub("_", "-", Cytokine_plot))

pairwise_wilcox_wide <- pairwise_wilcox_wide %>%
  mutate(across(-Cytokine_plot, ~ ifelse(
    !is.na(.),
    ifelse(. < 0.01, formatC(., format = "e", digits = 2), formatC(., format = "f", digits = 2)),
    NA
  )))

pairwise_wilcox_numeric <- pairwise_wilcox_wide %>%
  mutate(across(-Cytokine_plot, as.numeric))

library(gt)

gt_table <- pairwise_wilcox_wide %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Pairwise Comparisons of Cytokines by Ethnicity and HIV Status in CSTs I+II+V During Pregnancy",
    subtitle = "FDR-adjusted Wilcoxon P-values | Significant (p < 0.05) Results are in Bold"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(Cytokine_plot = "Cytokine") %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(14),
    heading.title.font.size = px(20),
    heading.subtitle.font.size = px(16)
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = everything() 
  ) %>%
   cols_width(
    everything() ~ px(120)  
  )

for(col in names(pairwise_wilcox_numeric)[-1]) { 
  gt_table <- gt_table %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = col,
        rows = pairwise_wilcox_numeric[[col]] < 0.05
      )
    )
}

gt_table

#gtsave(gt_table, "SupplementaryTable13.docx")


```

```{r}
gt_table <- pairwise_wilcox_wide %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Pairwise Comparisons of Cytokines by Ethnicity and HIV Status in CST IV During Pregnancy",
    subtitle = "FDR-adjusted Wilcoxon P-values | Significant (p < 0.05) Results are in Bold"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(Cytokine_plot = "Cytokine") %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(14),
    heading.title.font.size = px(20),
    heading.subtitle.font.size = px(16)
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = everything() 
  ) %>%
   cols_width(
    everything() ~ px(120)  
  )

for(col in names(pairwise_wilcox_numeric)[-1]) { 
  gt_table <- gt_table %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = col,
        rows = pairwise_wilcox_numeric[[col]] < 0.05
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Chao1 and PC1 within CSTs 

ps.alpha <- ps

ps.alpha <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps.alpha) >= 200, ps.alpha)

ad.metadats <- sample_data(ps.alpha)    

ad.metadats <- data.frame(ad.metadats)

ad.metadats$Ethnicity_HIV <- paste(ad.metadats$Ethnicity, ad.metadats$HIV_Status, sep=" ")

sample_data(ps.alpha) <- ad.metadats

adiv <- phyloseq::estimate_richness(ps.alpha, measures = c("Chao1")) %>% # perform this comparison with ps.alpha which is before singleton removal/prevalance filter 
  cbind(sample_data(ps.alpha)[, c("Ethnicity_HIV", "PID")]) %>%
  as.data.frame()

scores_df.adiv <- adiv %>%
  left_join(scores_df, by = "PID")

scores_df.adiv <- scores_df.adiv %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV.x = recode(
      Ethnicity_HIV.x,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+"  = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-"  = "White PWWH"
    )
  )

scores_df.adiv <- scores_df.adiv[!is.na(scores_df.adiv$CSTGroups), ]


cor_by_cst <- scores_df.adiv %>%
  group_by(CSTGroups) %>%
  summarize(
    rho = cor(Chao1, PC1, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
    p = cor.test(Chao1, PC1, method = "spearman")$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p.adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH") # adjust the p values across groups 
  )

cor_by_cst

cor_by_cst <- cor_by_cst %>%
  mutate(
    p.formatted = ifelse(
      p.adj < 0.01,
      sprintf("%.2e", p.adj),  
      sprintf("%.2f", p.adj)   
    )) 

print(cor_by_cst)  

scores_df.adiv <- scores_df.adiv %>%
  left_join(cor_by_cst, by = "CSTGroups")

scores_df.adiv$Ethnicity_HIV.x <- factor(scores_df.adiv$Ethnicity_HIV.x,
  levels = c("Black PWLWH", "Black PWWH", "White PWLWH", "White PWWH")
)


# Final pdf

p <- ggplot(scores_df.adiv, aes(x = PC1, y = Chao1, color = Ethnicity_HIV.x)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, aes(group = 1),
              color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = -Inf, y = Inf,
      label = paste0("rho = ", round(rho, 2), 
                     "\np = ", p.formatted)),
    hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 4, color = "black") +
    scale_color_manual(name = "Ethnicity and HIV Status", values = c(
  "Black PWLWH" = "#4C78A8",
  "White PWLWH" = "#F58518",
  "Black PWWH"  = "#72B7B2",
  "White PWWH"  = "#B279A2"
  )) + 
  labs(
    x = "PC1",
    y = "Chao1",
    color = "Ethnicity and HIV Status"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~CSTGroups) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
theme(
  axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
  axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
  legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",   
      fill = NA,        
      linewidth = 0.25), 
  axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2)
)
```
