```{r}
# Age and BMI correlation with PC1 

ps.alpha <- ps

ps.alpha <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps.alpha) >= 200, ps.alpha)

ad.metadats <- sample_data(ps.alpha)    

ad.metadats <- data.frame(ad.metadats)

ad.metadats$Ethnicity_HIV <- paste(ad.metadats$Ethnicity, ad.metadats$HIV_Status, sep=" ")

sample_data(ps.alpha) <- ad.metadats

adiv <- phyloseq::estimate_richness(ps.alpha, measures = c("Chao1")) %>% # perform this comparison with ps.alpha which is before singleton removal/prevalance filter 
  cbind(sample_data(ps.alpha)[, c("Ethnicity_HIV", "PID", "Body.Mass.Index.of.mother", "Age")]) %>%
  as.data.frame()

scores_df.adiv <- adiv %>%
  left_join(scores_df, by = "PID")

scores_df.adiv <- scores_df.adiv %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV.x = recode(
      Ethnicity_HIV.x,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+"  = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-"  = "White PWWH"
    )
  )

scores_df.adiv$Ethnicity_HIV <- factor(scores_df.adiv$Ethnicity_HIV.x, levels = c( "Black PWLWH", "Black PWWH", "White PWLWH", "White PWWH" ) )

# things of interest
Interest <- c("Age.x", "Body.Mass.Index.of.mother.x")

plot_list <- list()

scores_df.adiv$PC1 <- as.numeric(scores_df.adiv$PC1)

# Loop over each cytokine
for (int in Interest) {
  
  cor_data <- scores_df.adiv %>%
    dplyr::select(PC1, all_of(int)) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na()

  cor_overall <- cor.test(scores_df.adiv$PC1, scores_df.adiv[[int]], method = "spearman")
  
# make final pdf 
    
  # Generate plot
  p <- ggplot(scores_df.adiv, aes(x = PC1, y = .data[[int]], color = Ethnicity_HIV.x)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +

  "Black PWLWH" = "#4C78A8",
  "White PWLWH" = "#F58518",
  "Black PWWH"  = "#72B7B2",
  "White PWWH"  = "#B279A2"
  ))  + 
    labs(
      x = "PC1",
      y = int,
      color = "Ethnicity and HIV Status"
    ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
theme(
  axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
  axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
  legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(

      fill = NA,        
      linewidth = 0.25), 
  axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2)
) 
  
  plot_list[[int]] <- p
}
```

```{r}

# Cytokine PCA compared between CSTs within subgroups 

scores_df <- scores_df %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV = recode(
      Ethnicity_HIV,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+"  = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-"  = "White PWWH"
    )
  )

library(rstatix)
pairwise_results <- scores_df %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV) %>%                       
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    PC1 ~ CSTGroups,                          
    p.adjust.method = "fdr"                       
  ) %>%
    group_by(Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  mutate(y.position = max(scores_df$PC1[scores_df$Ethnicity_HIV == unique(Ethnicity_HIV)], na.rm = TRUE) + 1.75 * row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

pairwise_results <- pairwise_results %>%
  mutate(
    p_combined = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", p, p.adj)
  )


counts_df <- scores_df %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV, CSTGroups) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("n=", n))

library(dplyr)

counts_df <- counts_df %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV = recode(
      Ethnicity_HIV,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+"  = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-"  = "White PWWH"
    )
  )

# Generating overall figure first 

CSTInflammation <- ggplot(scores_df, aes(x = CSTGroups, y = PC1, fill = CSTGroups)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
 geom_label(
  data = counts_df,
  aes(x = CSTGroups, y = -6.5, label = label),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  fill = "white", color = "black", alpha = 0.8,
  label.size = 0.4, label.padding = unit(0.3, "lines")
) +
  facet_wrap(~Ethnicity_HIV) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "CST", values = c(
    "I+II+V" = "#006400",
    "III" = "#eb8a14",
    "IV" = "#8b0000"
  )) + 
  labs(
    x = "CST Group",
    y = "PC1 (Overall Inflammation)"
  )  +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
theme(
  axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
  axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
  legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",   
      fill = NA,        
      linewidth = 0.25), 
  axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2)
) +
  ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
    pairwise_results,
    label = "p_combined",
    xmin = "group1",
    xmax = "group2",
    y.position = "y.position",
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    tip.length = 0.02
  ) + 
  expand_limits(y = 11) +
  expand_limits(y = -7)

CSTInflammation
```

```{r}
  mutate(CSTIV = CST %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C"))

CSTModel_BlackHIV <- CSTModel_BlackHIV %>%
```

```{r}

# above were all adjusted models -- below code is to get FDR adjusted p values 

ptb_tests <- bind_rows(

  {
  age_ga <- CSTModel_BlackHIV %>%
    filter(!is.na(Age), !is.na(GADelivery))
  
  x <- cor.test(
    age_ga$Age,
    age_ga$GADelivery,
    method = "spearman",
    exact = FALSE
  )
  
  data.frame(
    test = "Age vs GA delivery",
    test_type = "Spearman",
    estimate = unname(x$estimate),
    p.value = x$p.value
  )
},

  {
    x <- fisher.test(table(CSTModel_BlackHIV$AMA, CSTModel_BlackHIV$Term))
    data.frame(test = "AMA vs Term", test_type = "Fisher", estimate = unname(x$estimate), p.value = x$p.value)
  },

  {
    x <- cor.test(CSTModel_BlackHIV$Gravidity, CSTModel_BlackHIV$GADelivery, method = "spearman")
    data.frame(test = "Gravidity vs GA delivery", test_type = "Spearman", estimate = unname(x$estimate), p.value = x$p.value)
  },

  {
    x <- fisher.test(table(CSTModel_BlackHIV$FirstPregnancy, CSTModel_BlackHIV$Term))
    data.frame(test = "First pregnancy vs Term", test_type = "Fisher", estimate = unname(x$estimate), p.value = x$p.value)
  },

  {
    x <- cor.test(CSTModel_BlackHIV$CD4, CSTModel_BlackHIV$GADelivery, method = "spearman")
    data.frame(test = "CD4 vs GA delivery", test_type = "Spearman", estimate = unname(x$estimate), p.value = x$p.value)
  },

  {
    x <- fisher.test(table(CSTModel_BlackHIV$Term, CSTModel_BlackHIV$DetectableHIV))
    data.frame(test = "Detectable HIV vs Term", test_type = "Fisher", estimate = unname(x$estimate), p.value = x$p.value)
  },

  {
    x <- fisher.test(table(CSTModel_BlackHIV$CSTIV, CSTModel_BlackHIV$Term))
    data.frame(test = "CST IV vs Term", test_type = "Fisher", estimate = unname(x$estimate), p.value = x$p.value)
  },

  {
    x <- fisher.test(table(CSTModel_BlackHIV$PreconYN, CSTModel_BlackHIV$Term))
    data.frame(test = "Preconception ART vs Term", test_type = "Fisher", estimate = unname(x$estimate), p.value = x$p.value)
  },

  {
    x <- fisher.test(table(CSTModel_BlackHIV_ARTGroup$ARTGroup_combined, CSTModel_BlackHIV_ARTGroup$Term))
    data.frame(test = "ART class vs Term", test_type = "Fisher", estimate = NA, p.value = x$p.value)
  },

  {
    x <- fisher.test(table(CSTModelHIV_Backbones$ARTBackbone, CSTModelHIV_Backbones$Term))
    data.frame(test = "ART backbone vs Term", test_type = "Fisher", estimate = unname(x$estimate), p.value = x$p.value)
  },

  {
    x <- cor.test(CSTModel_BlackHIV$BMI, CSTModel_BlackHIV$GADelivery, method = "spearman")
    data.frame(test = "BMI vs GA delivery", test_type = "Spearman", estimate = unname(x$estimate), p.value = x$p.value)
  },

  {
    x <- fisher.test(table(CSTModel_BlackHIV$Overweight, CSTModel_BlackHIV$Term))
    data.frame(test = "Overweight vs Term", test_type = "Fisher", estimate = unname(x$estimate), p.value = x$p.value)
  }

) %>%
  mutate(
    p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")
  )
```

```{r}
# Differential abundance (ANCOM) of Black PWLWH who gave birth preterm vs at term 

ps.cleaned <- prune_samples(sample_names(ps.filtered)[sample_data(ps.filtered)$Term.birth %in% c("Y","N")], ps.filtered)
ps.filtered_BH <- subset_samples(ps.cleaned, Ethnicity_HIV == "Black HIV+")

otu_mat <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps.filtered_BH))
tax_mat <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps.filtered_BH))

tax_mat$GenusSpecies <- ifelse(
  is.na(tax_mat$Species) | tax_mat$Species == "",
  tax_mat$Genus,
  paste(tax_mat$Genus, tax_mat$Species, sep = " ")
)

otu_agg <- aggregate(otu_mat, by = list(GenusSpecies = tax_mat$GenusSpecies), FUN = sum)
rownames(otu_agg) <- otu_agg$GenusSpecies
otu_agg$GenusSpecies <- NULL

tax_agg <- tax_mat[!duplicated(tax_mat$GenusSpecies), ]
rownames(tax_agg) <- tax_agg$GenusSpecies

tax_agg$GenusSpecies <- NULL

ps_genusspecies <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(as.matrix(otu_agg), taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
  tax_table(as.matrix(tax_agg)),
  sample_data(ps.filtered_BH)
)

ps_genusspecies
rank_names(ps_genusspecies)


library(ANCOMBC)
output <- ancombc2(
  data = ps_genusspecies,
  fix_formula = "Term.birth",             
  rand_formula = NULL,                   
  p_adj_method = "fdr",                 
  pseudo_sens = TRUE,                    
  prv_cut = 0.10,                        
  lib_cut = 1000,                         
  s0_perc = 0.05,                        
  group = "Term.birth",                     
  struc_zero = TRUE,                      
  neg_lb = TRUE,                          
  alpha = 0.05,                           
  n_cl = 2                             
)

sig_res <- output$res

sig_results <- data.frame(
  Taxa = sig_res$taxon,
  Beta = sig_res$lfc_Term.birthY, 
  pval = sig_res$p_Term.birthY,
  qval = sig_res$q_Term.birthY
)


sig_results <- sig_results[order(sig_results$pval), ]
sig_results_sig <- sig_results %>% filter (pval < 0.05)


sig_results_sig
```

```{r}
count_data <- asv_raw[, -1, drop = FALSE]

count_data[] <- lapply(count_data, as.numeric)

otu_mat <- as.matrix(count_data)

tax_split <- strsplit(taxonomy_strings, ";")

tax_mat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tax_split, function(x) {
  length(x) <- 7
  return(x)
}))

colnames(tax_mat) <- c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")
rownames(tax_mat) <- asv_ids

OTU <- otu_table(otu_mat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
TAX <- tax_table(as.matrix(tax_mat))
ps <- phyloseq(OTU, TAX)
```

```{r}
# Creating overall CST change figure 

# overall CST change figure - not stratified by subgroups 

library(ggalluvial)

CSTTransition <- data.frame(
  SampleID = metadata.filtered$PID,
  CST = metadata.filtered$CST,
  Timepoint = metadata.filtered$My_timepoint
)

CSTTransition$Timepoint <- factor(CSTTransition$Timepoint, 
                                              levels = c(1, 2), 
                                              labels = c("1", "2"))

CSTTransition <- CSTTransition %>%
  filter(!is.na(CST))


stratum_props <- CSTTransition %>%
  group_by(Timepoint, CST) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    label_single_line = paste0(
      CST, " - n=", n, " (", scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 1), ")"
    )
  )

stratum_props

# Join both prop and CST to CSTTransition
CSTTransition_labeled <- CSTTransition %>%
  left_join(
    stratum_props %>% select(Timepoint, CST, prop, label_single_line),
    by = c("Timepoint", "CST")
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = label_single_line)


# final pdf of cst change figure 

# make CST label without the percentages or n labels 

stratum_props <- CSTTransition %>%
  group_by(Timepoint, CST) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    label_single_line = paste0(
      CST)
  )

CSTTransition_labeled <- CSTTransition %>%
  left_join(
    stratum_props %>% select(Timepoint, CST, prop, label_single_line),
    by = c("Timepoint", "CST")
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = label_single_line)

# suppress CST IV-C

CSTTransition_labeled$label <- ifelse(
  CSTTransition_labeled$CST == "IV-C",
  "",
  CSTTransition_labeled$label
)

CSTTransition_plot <- ggplot(CSTTransition_labeled,
           aes(x = Timepoint, stratum = CST, alluvium = SampleID,
               fill = CST, label = label)) +
  geom_flow(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_stratum(alpha = 0.9, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", size = 3, lineheight = 0.9) +
   scale_fill_manual(
    name = "CST",
    values = c(
      "I" = "#66a61e",
      "II" = "steelblue",
      "III" = "khaki",
      "IV-A" = "indianred",
      "IV-B" = "darksalmon",
      "IV-C" = "rosybrown1",
      "V" = "thistle"

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(x = "Timepoint",
       y = "Number of Samples") + 
theme(
```

```{r}

# CST change figure by subgroup 

library(ggalluvial)

CSTTransition <- data.frame(
  SampleID = metadata.filtered$PID,
  CST = metadata.filtered$CST,
  Timepoint = metadata.filtered$My_timepoint,
  Ethnicity_HIV = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity_HIV
)

CSTTransition$Timepoint <- factor(CSTTransition$Timepoint, 
                                              levels = c(1, 2), 
                                              labels = c("1", "2"))

CSTTransition <- CSTTransition %>%
  filter(!is.na(CST))


stratum_props <- CSTTransition %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV, Timepoint, CST) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV, Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    label_single_line = paste0(CST, " - ", scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 1))
  )

# Join both prop and CST to CSTTransition
CSTTransition_labeled <- CSTTransition %>%
  left_join(
    stratum_props %>% select(Ethnicity_HIV, Timepoint, CST, prop, label_single_line),
    by = c("Ethnicity_HIV", "Timepoint", "CST")
  ) %>%
  # Now use the one-line label with dash
  mutate(label = label_single_line)

counts <- CSTTransition %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(SampleID))

facet_labels <- paste0(counts$Ethnicity_HIV, "\n", "n = ", counts$n)
names(facet_labels) <- counts$Ethnicity_HIV


CSTTransition_labeled$Ethnicity_HIV <- factor(
  CSTTransition_labeled$Ethnicity_HIV,
  levels = c("Black PWLWH", "Black PWWH", "White PWLWH", "White PWWH")
)

# change counts by subgroup  

cst_wide <- CSTTransition %>%
  select(SampleID, Timepoint, CST, Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = CST,
              names_prefix = "TP")

change_summary <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(
    change_type = case_when(
      TP1 == TP2 ~ "Same CST",
      TRUE ~ "Different CST"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV, change_type) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

print(change_summary)

# Black PWLWH transitions - IV collapsed 

cst_wideBW <- CSTTransition %>%
  filter(Ethnicity_HIV == "Black PWLWH") %>%
  mutate(
    CST_collapsed = case_when(
      CST %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C") ~ "IV",
      TRUE ~ CST
    )
  ) %>%
  select(SampleID, Timepoint, CST_collapsed) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = CST_collapsed,
              names_prefix = "TP")

transitions_BW <- cst_wideBW %>%
  filter(!is.na(TP1), !is.na(TP2)) %>%
  filter(TP1 != TP2)

transition_counts_raw <- transitions_BW %>%
  count(TP1, TP2, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    transition = paste0(TP1, " → ", TP2)
  )

transition_counts_raw %>%
  filter(
    (TP1 == "III" & TP2 == "IV") |
    (TP1 == "IV" & TP2 == "III")
  ) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(n))

summary_table <- tibble(
  III_IV_transitions = transition_counts_raw %>%
    filter((TP1 == "III" & TP2 == "IV") | (TP1 == "IV" & TP2 == "III")) %>%
    summarise(n = sum(n)) %>% pull(n),

  into_III_IV = transition_counts_raw %>%
    filter(TP2 %in% c("III", "IV") & !(TP1 %in% c("III", "IV"))) %>%
    summarise(n = sum(n)) %>% pull(n)
)

print(summary_table)

# transitions between I+II+V or III+IV 

CSTTransition2 <- CSTTransition %>%
  mutate(
    CST_group = case_when(
      CST %in% c("I", "II", "V") ~ "I+II+V",
      CST %in% c("III", "IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C") ~ "III+IV",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

cst_wide <- CSTTransition2 %>%
  select(SampleID, Ethnicity_HIV, Timepoint, CST_group) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = CST_group,
              names_prefix = "TP")


cst_transitions <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(
    transition = case_when(
      TP1 == TP2 ~ "No change",
      TP1 == "I+II+V" & TP2 == "III+IV" ~ "I+II+V → III+IV",
      TP1 == "III+IV" & TP2 == "I+II+V" ~ "III+IV → I+II+V",
      TRUE ~ "Other/NA"
    )
  )

transition_summary <- cst_transitions %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV, transition) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    percent = scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 1),
    `n (%)` = paste0(n, " (", percent, ")")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Ethnicity_HIV, transition, `n (%)`)

print(transition_summary)

# pdf version 

# new label without % 

stratum_props <- CSTTransition %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV, Timepoint, CST) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV, Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    label_single_line = paste0(CST)
  )

# Join both prop and CST to CSTTransition
CSTTransition_labeled <- CSTTransition %>%
  left_join(
    stratum_props %>% select(Ethnicity_HIV, Timepoint, CST, prop, label_single_line),
    by = c("Ethnicity_HIV", "Timepoint", "CST")
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = label_single_line)

facet_labels <- paste0(counts$Ethnicity_HIV, "\n", "n = ", counts$n)
names(facet_labels) <- counts$Ethnicity_HIV

CSTTransition_plot <- ggplot(CSTTransition_labeled,
           aes(x = Timepoint, stratum = CST, alluvium = SampleID,
               fill = CST, label = label)) +
  geom_flow(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_stratum(alpha = 0.9, linewidth = 0.3) +
   scale_fill_manual(
    name = "CST",
    values = c(
      "I" = "#66a61e",
      "II" = "steelblue",
      "III" = "khaki",
      "IV-A" = "indianred",
      "IV-B" = "darksalmon",
      "IV-C" = "rosybrown1",
      "V" = "thistle"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = "Timepoint",
       y = "Number of Samples") +
  facet_wrap(~ Ethnicity_HIV, nrow = 2, ncol = 2, labeller = labeller(Ethnicity_HIV = facet_labels)) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
theme(

)
```

```{r}

# CST change regression models 

CSTTransition <- data.frame(
  SampleID = metadata.filtered$PID,
  CST = metadata.filtered$CST,
  Timepoint = metadata.filtered$My_timepoint,
  Ethnicity_HIV = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity_HIV,
  BMI = metadata.filtered$Body.Mass.Index.of.mother,
  Age = metadata.filtered$Age,
  VisitDate = metadata.filtered$Visit.Date,
  Ethnicity = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity,
  HIV = metadata.filtered$HIV
  )

CSTTransition <- CSTTransition %>%
  mutate(CST = as.character(CST))

pid_info <- CSTTransition %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Ethnicity_HIV, BMI, Age, Ethnicity, HIV) %>%
  distinct()

timepoint_CST <- CSTTransition %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Timepoint, CST, VisitDate) %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c(1,2))

cst_wide <- timepoint_CST %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Timepoint,
    values_from = c(CST, VisitDate),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_prefix = "Timepoint_"
  )

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  left_join(pid_info, by = "SampleID") %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, everything())

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>% filter(!is.na(Age) & !is.na(BMI))

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(transitions_to_III_IV = CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("I", "II", "v") &
                             CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("IV-B", "IV-A", "IV-C", "III"),
         transitions_to_I_II_V = CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C", "III") &
                             CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("I", "II", "V"),
         stability = ifelse(CST_Timepoint_1 == CST_Timepoint_2, TRUE, FALSE))

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(VisitDate_Timepoint_2 = as.Date(VisitDate_Timepoint_2, format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
    VisitDate_Timepoint_1 = as.Date(VisitDate_Timepoint_1, format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
    Days_between = as.numeric(VisitDate_Timepoint_2 - VisitDate_Timepoint_1), 
    Weeks_between = as.numeric(Days_between / 7))

cst_wide$stability <- factor(cst_wide$stability,
                             levels = c(TRUE, FALSE))

# Odds of CST stability by Ethnicity*HIV 

model <- glm(stability ~ Ethnicity_HIV + Age + BMI, family = binomial, data = cst_wide)
summary(model)

library(emmeans)

emmeans(model, pairwise ~ Ethnicity_HIV, type = "response")

# Odds of CST stability by Ethnicity+HIV 

cst_wide$HIV <- relevel(
  cst_wide$HIV,
  ref = "PWWH"
)

model <- glm(stability ~ Ethnicity + HIV + Age + BMI, family = binomial, data = cst_wide)
summary(model)

# OR for above model 

library(broom)

results <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%   # remove intercept
  mutate(
    report = paste0(
      "aOR ", round(estimate, 2),
      ", 95% CI ", round(conf.low, 2),
      "–", round(conf.high, 2),
      "; p = ", signif(p.value, 2)
    )
  )

results %>% select(term, report)

print(results)

# Odds of CST stability by Ethnicity_HIV_Grouping (Black PWLWH vs vs everyone else)

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV_Grouping = case_when(
      Ethnicity_HIV == "Black PWLWH" ~ "Black PWLWH",
      TRUE ~ "Other"   # everything else goes into the other group
    )
  )


cst_wide$Ethnicity_HIV_Grouping <- factor(cst_wide$Ethnicity_HIV_Grouping)

cst_wide$Ethnicity_HIV_Grouping <- relevel(
  cst_wide$Ethnicity_HIV_Grouping,
  ref = "Other"
)

model <- glm(stability ~ Ethnicity_HIV_Grouping + Age + BMI, family = binomial, data = cst_wide)
summary(model)


library(broom)

results <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%   # remove intercept
  mutate(
    report = paste0(
      "aOR ", round(estimate, 2),
      ", 95% CI ", round(conf.low, 2),
      "–", round(conf.high, 2),
      "; p = ", signif(p.value, 2)
    )
  )

results %>% select(term, report)

# Odds of having CST I, II, V at any timepoint based on HIV/Ethnicity 

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(
    Had_CST_I_II_V = if_else(
      CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("I", "II", "V") | CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("I", "II", "V"),
      TRUE,   
      FALSE   
    )
  )

cst_wide$Had_CST_I_II_V = factor(cst_wide$Had_CST_I_II_V, levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE"))


model <- glm(Had_CST_I_II_V ~ Ethnicity_HIV + BMI + Age , family = binomial, data = cst_wide)
summary(model)

library(emmeans)

em_model <- emmeans(model, pairwise ~ Ethnicity_HIV, type = "response", infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))

contrasts_df <- as.data.frame(em_model$contrasts)

sig <- contrasts_df %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.10) %>%
  mutate(
    aOR = ifelse(odds.ratio < 1, 1 / odds.ratio, odds.ratio),
    LCL = ifelse(odds.ratio < 1, 1 / asymp.UCL, asymp.LCL),
    UCL = ifelse(odds.ratio < 1, 1 / asymp.LCL, asymp.UCL),
    report = paste0(
      "p:", round(p.value, 2),
      "aOR: ", round(aOR, 2),
      ", 95% CI: ", round(LCL, 2),
      "–", round(UCL, 2)
    )
  )

sig %>% select(contrast, report)




```

```{r}
# testing if weeks between is SD by Ethnicity_HIV groups

  )

CSTTransition <- CSTTransition %>%

pid_info <- CSTTransition %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Ethnicity_HIV, BMI, Age, Ethnicity, HIV) %>%
  distinct()

timepoint_CST <- CSTTransition %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Timepoint, CST, VisitDate) %>%

cst_wide <- timepoint_CST %>%

    names_prefix = "Timepoint_"
  )

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  left_join(pid_info, by = "SampleID") %>%

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(VisitDate_Timepoint_2 = as.Date(VisitDate_Timepoint_2, format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
    VisitDate_Timepoint_1 = as.Date(VisitDate_Timepoint_1, format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
    Days_between = as.numeric(VisitDate_Timepoint_2 - VisitDate_Timepoint_1), 
    Weeks_between = as.numeric(Days_between / 7))


cst_wide$Ethnicity_HIV <- as.factor(cst_wide$Ethnicity_HIV)
cst_wide$Days_between <- as.numeric(cst_wide$Days_between)

kruskal.test(Days_between ~ Ethnicity_HIV, data = cst_wide)

avg_weeks <- mean(cst_wide$Weeks_between, na.rm = TRUE) # average weeks between two appointments 

print(avg_weeks)

cst_wide$BMI <- as.numeric(cst_wide$BMI)
cst_wide$Age <- as.numeric(cst_wide$Age)
cst_wide$Weeks_between <- as.numeric(cst_wide$Weeks_between)

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV_Grouping = case_when(
      Ethnicity_HIV == "Black PWLWH" ~ "Black PWLWH",
      TRUE ~ "Other"   # everything else goes into the other group
    )

# median and range weeks for supplementary by subgroup

print(WeeksBetween_table)

# overall weeks between
```

```{r}

# Odds of change/stability by subgroup within various CSTs 

CSTTransition <- data.frame(
  SampleID = metadata.filtered$PID,
  CST = metadata.filtered$CST,
  Timepoint = metadata.filtered$My_timepoint,
  Ethnicity_HIV = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity_HIV,
  BMI = metadata.filtered$Body.Mass.Index.of.mother,
  Age = metadata.filtered$Age,
  VisitDate = metadata.filtered$Visit.Date,
  Ethnicity = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity,
  HIV = metadata.filtered$HIV
  )

CSTTransition <- CSTTransition %>%
  mutate(CST = as.character(CST))

pid_info <- CSTTransition %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Ethnicity_HIV, BMI, Age, Ethnicity, HIV) %>%
  distinct()

timepoint_CST <- CSTTransition %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Timepoint, CST, VisitDate) %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c(1,2))

cst_wide <- timepoint_CST %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Timepoint,
    values_from = c(CST, VisitDate),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_prefix = "Timepoint_"
  )

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  left_join(pid_info, by = "SampleID") %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, everything())

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>% filter(!is.na(Age) & !is.na(BMI))

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(transitions_to_III_IV = CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("I", "II", "v") &
                             CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("IV-B", "IV-A", "IV-C", "III"),
         transitions_to_I_II_V = CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C", "III") &
                             CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("I", "II", "V"),
         stability = ifelse(CST_Timepoint_1 == CST_Timepoint_2, TRUE, FALSE))

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(VisitDate_Timepoint_2 = as.Date(VisitDate_Timepoint_2, format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
    VisitDate_Timepoint_1 = as.Date(VisitDate_Timepoint_1, format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
    Days_between = as.numeric(VisitDate_Timepoint_2 - VisitDate_Timepoint_1), 
    Weeks_between = as.numeric(Days_between / 7))

cst_wide$stability<- factor(cst_wide$stability, levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE")) # testing odds of change 
cst_wide$BMI <- as.numeric(cst_wide$BMI)
cst_wide$Age <- as.numeric(cst_wide$Age)
cst_wide$Weeks_between <- as.numeric(cst_wide$Weeks_between)

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
    mutate(
    CST_Group_T1 = case_when(
      CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("I", "II", "V") ~ "I_II_V",
      CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C") ~ "IV",
      CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("III") ~ "III",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Main model to explore the interaction between CST @ timepoint 1 and HIV_Ethnicity and their effect on stability (adjusted for BMI/age) - all ns  

model <- glm(stability ~ CST_Group_T1 * Ethnicity_HIV + Age + BMI, family = binomial, data = cst_wide)

summary(model)

# below models were exploratory and simple (no covariates) and all ns so no further testing was explored 

# for samples in CSTs I, II, V at timepoint 1, does stability vary by ethnicity*HIV? 

cst_wide_I_II_V = cst_wide %>% filter (CST_Group_T1 == "I_II_V")

model <- glm(stability ~ Ethnicity_HIV, family = binomial, data = cst_wide_I_II_V)
summary(model)

library(emmeans)

emmeans(model, pairwise ~ Ethnicity_HIV, type = "response")

# for samples in CST III at T1, does stability vary by ethnicity*HIV? 

cst_wide_III = cst_wide %>% filter (CST_Group_T1 == "III")

model <- glm(stability ~ Ethnicity_HIV, family = binomial, data = cst_wide_III)
summary(model)

library(emmeans)

emmeans(model, pairwise ~ Ethnicity_HIV, type = "response")

# filter out black pwwh for above model?

cst_wide_III_Fil = cst_wide_III %>% filter (Ethnicity_HIV != "Black PWWH")

model <- glm(stability ~ Ethnicity_HIV, family = binomial, data = cst_wide_III_Fil)
summary(model)

# for samples in CST IV at T1, does stability vary by ethnicity*HIV? 

cst_wide_IV = cst_wide %>% filter (CST_Group_T1 == "IV")

model <- glm(stability ~ Ethnicity_HIV, family = binomial, data = cst_wide_IV)
summary(model)

library(emmeans)

# try to look at III+IV grouped and see if stability varies 

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
    mutate(
    CST_Group_T1_III_IV = case_when(
      CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("I", "II", "V") ~ "I_II_V",
      CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C", "III") ~ "III+IV",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

cst_wide_III_IV = cst_wide %>% filter (CST_Group_T1_III_IV == "III+IV")

model <- glm(stability ~ Ethnicity_HIV, family = binomial, data = cst_wide_III_IV)
summary(model)

library(emmeans)

emmeans(model, pairwise ~ Ethnicity_HIV, type = "response")

```


```{r}

# table with CST change data 

CSTTransition <- data.frame(
  SampleID = metadata.filtered$PID,
  CST = metadata.filtered$CST,
  Timepoint = metadata.filtered$My_timepoint,
  Ethnicity_HIV = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity_HIV
  )

CSTTransition <- CSTTransition %>%
  mutate(CST = as.character(CST))

pid_info <- CSTTransition %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  distinct()

timepoint_CST <- CSTTransition %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Timepoint, CST) %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c(1,2))

cst_wide <- timepoint_CST %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Timepoint,
    values_from = c(CST),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_prefix = "Timepoint_"
  )

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  left_join(pid_info, by = "SampleID") %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, everything())

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
    mutate(
    Timepoint_1 = case_when(
      Timepoint_1 %in% c("I") ~ "I",
      Timepoint_1 %in% c("II") ~ "II",
      Timepoint_1 %in% c("V") ~ "V",
      Timepoint_1 %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C") ~ "IV",
      Timepoint_1 %in% c("III") ~ "III",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
    mutate(
    Timepoint_2 = case_when(
      Timepoint_2 %in% c("I") ~ "I",
      Timepoint_2 %in% c("II") ~ "II",
      Timepoint_2 %in% c("V") ~ "V",
      Timepoint_2 %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C") ~ "IV",
      Timepoint_2 %in% c("III") ~ "III",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(Stability = ifelse(Timepoint_1 == Timepoint_2, TRUE, FALSE))

# calculate stability at each timepoint

summary <- cst_wide %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV, Timepoint_1, Stability) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV, Timepoint_1) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(count, " (", round(100 * count / sum(count), 2), "%)")) %>%
  select(Ethnicity_HIV, Timepoint_1, Stability, label) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Stability, values_from = label, values_fill = "0 (0%)") %>%
  rename(`Stable CST` = `TRUE`, `CST Change` = `FALSE`) %>%
  ungroup()


library(gt)

summary_gt <- summary %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Stable CST`, `CST Change`), names_to = "Stability_type", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(col_name = paste0(Timepoint_1, "_", Stability_type)) %>%
  select(Ethnicity_HIV, col_name, Value) %>%
 pivot_wider(names_from = col_name,
              values_from = Value,
              values_fill = list(Value = "0 (0%)"))

gt_table <- gt(summary_gt, rowname_col = "Ethnicity_HIV")

csts <- unique(summary$Timepoint_1)
for(cst in csts){
  cols <- grep(paste0("^", cst, "_"), names(summary_gt), value = TRUE)
  gt_table <- gt_table %>%
    tab_spanner(label = cst, columns = cols) %>%
    cols_label(
  !!paste0(cst, "_Stable CST") := "Stable",
  !!paste0(cst, "_CST Change") := "Changed"
)
}

gt_table


# ideas below to make it more readable 

gt_table <- gt_table %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = everything()
  )

gt_table <- gt_table %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_row_groups()
  )


gt_table <- gt_table %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "CST Stability by Ethnicity and HIV Status",
    subtitle = "Counts (%) of Stable and Changed CSTs by CST at Timepoint 1"
  )

last_cst <- tail(csts, 1)

gt_table <- gt_table %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(sides = "right", color = "darkgray", weight = px(2)),
    locations = cells_column_spanners(
      spanners = setdiff(csts, last_cst)
    )
  )

for (cst in setdiff(csts, last_cst)) {

  cols <- grep(paste0("^", cst, "_"), names(summary_gt), value = TRUE)
  if (length(cols) == 0) next

  last_col <- tail(cols, 1)

  gt_table <- gt_table %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_borders(sides = "right", color = "darkgray", weight = px(2)),
      locations = cells_column_labels(columns = last_col)
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_borders(sides = "right", color = "darkgray", weight = px(2)),
      locations = cells_body(columns = last_col)
    )
}


gt_table

```


```{r}

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# BLACK PWLWH PTB ANALYSIS - LONGITUDINAL USING ABOVE DATASET
# -----------------------------------------------------------

CSTTransition <- data.frame(
  SampleID = metadata.filtered$PID,
  CST = metadata.filtered$CST,
  Timepoint = metadata.filtered$My_timepoint,
  Ethnicity_HIV = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity_HIV,
  BMI = metadata.filtered$Body.Mass.Index.of.mother,
  Age = metadata.filtered$Age,
  VisitDate = metadata.filtered$Visit.Date,
  Ethnicity = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity,
  HIV = metadata.filtered$HIV,
  Term = metadata.filtered$Term.birth
  )

CSTTransition <- CSTTransition %>%
  mutate(CST = as.character(CST))

pid_info <- CSTTransition %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Ethnicity_HIV, BMI, Age, Ethnicity, HIV, Term) %>%
  distinct()

timepoint_CST <- CSTTransition %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Timepoint, CST, VisitDate) %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c(1,2))

cst_wide <- timepoint_CST %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Timepoint,
    values_from = c(CST, VisitDate),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_prefix = "Timepoint_"
  )

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  left_join(pid_info, by = "SampleID") %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, everything())


cst_wide <- cst_wide %>% filter(!is.na(Age) & !is.na(BMI))

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(transitions_to_III_IV = CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("I", "II", "v") &
                             CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("IV-B", "IV-A", "IV-C", "III"),
         transitions_to_I_II_V = CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C", "III") &
                             CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("I", "II", "V"),
         stability = ifelse(CST_Timepoint_1 == CST_Timepoint_2, TRUE, FALSE))

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(VisitDate_Timepoint_2 = as.Date(VisitDate_Timepoint_2, format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
    VisitDate_Timepoint_1 = as.Date(VisitDate_Timepoint_1, format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
    Days_between = as.numeric(VisitDate_Timepoint_2 - VisitDate_Timepoint_1), 
    Weeks_between = as.numeric(Days_between / 7))

cst_wide$stability<- factor(cst_wide$stability, levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE")) # testing odds of change 
cst_wide$BMI <- as.numeric(cst_wide$BMI)
cst_wide$Age <- as.numeric(cst_wide$Age)
cst_wide$Weeks_between <- as.numeric(cst_wide$Weeks_between)


cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(
    Had_CST_I_II_V = if_else(
      CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("I", "II", "V") | CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("I", "II", "V"),
      TRUE,   
      FALSE   
    )
  )

cst_wide$Had_CST_I_II_V = factor(cst_wide$Had_CST_I_II_V, levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE"))

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
    mutate(
    CST_Group_T1 = case_when(
      CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("I", "II", "V") ~ "I_II_V",
      CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C", "III") ~ "IV_subtypes",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(
    CST_Group_T2 = case_when(
      CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("I", "II", "V") ~ "I_II_V",
      CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C", "III") ~ "IV_subtypes",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# PTB models 

cst_wide_filtered <- cst_wide %>% filter(Ethnicity_HIV == "Black PWLWH")

cst_wide_filtered$Term <- factor(cst_wide_filtered$Term, levels = c("Y", "N"))

# Transition data

cst_wide_filtered1 <- cst_wide_filtered %>%
  filter(Term == "N") %>%
  mutate(
    Transition = paste0(CST_Timepoint_1, " -> ", CST_Timepoint_2)
  )

cst_wide_filterted_transitions <- cst_wide_filtered1 %>%
  select(Transition)

print(cst_wide_filterted_transitions)

# CST stability on odds of PTB 

model <- glm(Term ~ stability, family = binomial, data = cst_wide_filtered)
summary(model)

library(broom)

results <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%   
  mutate(
    report = paste0(
      "OR", round(estimate, 2),
      ", 95% CI ", round(conf.low, 2),
      "–", round(conf.high, 2),
      "; p = ", signif(p.value, 2)
    )
  )

results %>% select(term, report)



# Transition between III/IV vs not (True/False if it was experienced)

cst_wide_filtered <- cst_wide_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    # Collapse CST IV subtypes into "IV", everything else stays as is
    CST_TP1_group = if_else(CST_Timepoint_1 == "III", "III",
                             if_else(CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("IV-A","IV-B","IV-C"), "IV",
                                     "Other")),
    CST_TP2_group = if_else(CST_Timepoint_2 == "III", "III",
                             if_else(CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("IV-A","IV-B","IV-C"), "IV",
                                     "Other")),
    
    # TRUE if III ↔ IV transition, FALSE otherwise
    CST_III_IV_Transition_Any = if_else(
      (CST_TP1_group == "III" & CST_TP2_group == "IV") |
      (CST_TP1_group == "IV"  & CST_TP2_group == "III"),
      TRUE,
      FALSE
    )
  )

model <- glm(Term ~ CST_III_IV_Transition_Any, family = binomial, data = cst_wide_filtered)
summary(model)


library(broom)

results <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>% 
  mutate(
    report = paste0(
      "OR", round(estimate, 2),
      ", 95% CI ", round(conf.low, 2),
      "–", round(conf.high, 2),
      "; p = ", signif(p.value, 2)
    )
  )

results %>% select(term, report)

# defined transitions (I+II+V to III/IV or vice versa)

model <- glm(Term ~ transitions_to_III_IV, family = binomial, data = cst_wide_filtered)
summary(model)

model <- glm(Term ~ transitions_to_I_II_V, family = binomial, data = cst_wide_filtered)
summary(model)

# Does the CST grouping at timepoint 1 or 2 impact odds of PTB? 

cst_wide_filtered <- cst_wide_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    CST1_Group = case_when(
      CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("I", "II", "V") ~ "I_II_V",
      CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("III", "IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C") ~ "III_IV",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    CST2_Group = case_when(
      CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("I", "II", "V") ~ "I_II_V",
      CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("III", "IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C") ~ "III_IV",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

model <- glm(Term ~ CST_Group_T1 + CST_Group_T2, family = binomial, data = cst_wide_filtered)
summary(model)

```
